data.title: Show HN: ggc – A terminal-based Git CLI written in Go
data.author: bmf-san
data.article_summary: **ggc** 是一个用 Go 编写的现代 Git 命令行工具，提供传统命令行操作和交互式增量搜索界面。用户可以直接运行如 `ggc add` 等子命令，或仅输入 `ggc` 进入交互模式，通过增量搜索选择命令。它具有快速、用户友好和可扩展的特点，支持复合命令和交互式分支/文件选择及消息输入。安装可通过预编译二进制文件、脚本或 `go install` 完成。开发者可以使用 Makefile 安装依赖、运行格式化工具、测试和构建项目。使用交互模式时，用户可通过输入过滤命令，使用快捷键导航，执行后返回命令选择界面。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Git工作流及相关工具的使用和意见

不同观点：
• [bmf-san] 提出的问题集中在Git日常工作流的具体细节上，包括：
  1. 主要使用的Git客户端：CLI、GUI工具、IDE集成还是自定义脚本，以及选择的原因。
  2. 工作流快捷方式：是遵循经典的`git add → commit → push`步骤，还是通过别名或脚本将其打包在一起执行。
  3. 交互任务处理：如何处理分阶段任务（如暂存块、解决冲突、浏览历史）。
  4. 别名和脚本维护：如果使用自定义别名或函数，如何保持其组织性和可共享性。

• [JdeBP] 关注技术细节，指出终端显示异常的问题，并提供了技术背景解释，提到终端行规程进入原始模式导致的问题，同时附上了相关的代码链接以供参考。

• [johnisgood] 提到对LLM（语言模型）生成内容的怀疑，但表示理解和接受，并分享了自己使用的工具：lazygit、magit和Git Cola，同时建议演示GIF可以更复杂一些，比如展示添加和删除特定块的操作。

• [awestroke] 对[bmf-san]提到的“基于终端的CLI”表示困惑，反问“相对于什么？”，表明对术语使用的疑问。

• [scosman] 提出命名建议，认为项目名称与GCC（GNU Compiler Collection）过于接近，可能会引起混淆。

• [donatj] 表示对项目调用原生git二进制文件的欣慰，提到自己曾遇到过纯Go实现的git非常慢的问题。

• [joshka] 从术语准确性角度出发，认为项目更应该被称为REPL（读取-求值-打印循环）而不是CLI（命令行界面）。

• [nikolayasdf123] 对项目要求中提到的“必须安装git命令”表示疑问，询问项目是否只是一个git的包装器。

补充讨论：
- 评论中涉及到对工具使用、技术细节、命名建议以及术语准确性的多方面讨论。
- 部分评论如[JdeBP]提供了技术背景和代码链接，增加了讨论的深度。
- [johnisgood]的评论引入了对LLM生成内容的讨论，反映了当前技术社区对AI辅助开发的关注。
- 对项目名称的建议和项目是否为git包装器的疑问显示出对项目定位和理解的差异。

ggc
A Go Git CLI.
This logo was created by
gopherize.me
.
Demo
Overview
ggc is a Git tool written in Go, offering both traditional CLI commands and an interactive interface with incremental search. You can either run subcommands like ggc add directly, or launch the interactive mode by simply typing ggc. Designed to be fast, user-friendly, and extensible.
Features
Traditional command-line interface (CLI): Run ggc  [args] to execute specific operations directly.
Interactive interface: Run ggc with no arguments to launch an incremental search UI for command selection.
Simple commands for common Git operations (add, push, pull, branch, log, etc.)
Composite commands that combine multiple Git operations
Interactive UI for branch/file selection and message input
Implemented using the Go standard library and:
golang.org/x/term
– for terminal interaction
golang.org/x/sys
– for low-level OS interaction
gopkg.in/yaml.v3
– for parsing
~/.ggcconfig.yaml
Supported Environments
OS: macOS (Apple Silicon/Intel) - Verified
Go version: 1.24 or later recommended
Dependencies: Go standard library,
golang.org/x/term
,
golang.org/x/sys
,
gopkg.in/yaml.v3
Requirement:
git
command must be installed
Installation
Pre-compiled Binaries (Recommended)
Pre-compiled binaries are available for multiple platforms and architectures. This is the fastest way to get started with
ggc
.
Download from Releases
Visit the
Releases
page to download the latest binary for your platform:
Supported Platforms:
macOS:
darwin_amd64
(Intel),
darwin_arm64
(Apple Silicon)
Linux:
linux_amd64
,
linux_arm64
Windows:
windows_amd64
Quick Install with Script
The easiest way to install
ggc
is using the provided installation script:
#
Download and run the installation script
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bmf-san/ggc/main/install.sh
|
bash
Or download and run it manually:
#
Download the script
curl -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bmf-san/ggc/main/install.sh
#
Make it executable
chmod +x install.sh
#
Run the script
./install.sh
The script will:
Detect your operating system and architecture
Download the appropriate binary for your system
Install using
git
, manual
go install
fallback
Verify the installation
Build with make
git clone
<
repository URL
>
make build
Place the
ggc
binary in a directory included in your PATH.
Development Setup
For development, you can use the Makefile to install required tools and dependencies:
#
Install all dependencies and tools
make deps
#
Run formatter
make fmt
#
Run tests
make
test
#
Run linter
make lint
#
Run tests with coverage
make cover
#
Run tests and lint
make test-and-lint
#
Build with go build
make build
#
Build and run with version info
make run
The Makefile will automatically install required tools like
golangci-lint
using
go install
.
Global install with go install
go install github.com/bmf-san/ggc@latest
The
ggc
binary will be installed to
$GOBIN
(usually
$HOME/go/bin
).
If
$GOBIN
is in your
PATH
, you can use
ggc
from anywhere.
If not, add it to your
PATH
:
Note
When using
go install
, you may get limited version info due to
ldflags
not working with
go install
. It is recommended to build with make build or use the install script or binaries.
export
PATH=
$PATH
:
$(
go env GOBIN
)
#
or
export
PATH=
$PATH
:
$HOME
/go/bin
Usage
Interactive Command Selection (Incremental Search UI)
Just run:
ggc
Type to filter commands (incremental search)
Use ctrl+n/ctrl+p to move selection, Enter to execute
If a command requires arguments (e.g.
<file>
,
<name>
,
<url>
), you will be prompted for input (always left-aligned)
After command execution, results are displayed and you can press Enter to continue
After viewing results, you return to the command selection screen for continuous use
Use "quit" command or ctrl+c to exit interactive mode
All UI and prompts are in English
Available Commands
Command
Description
add <file>
Add specific file to the index
add .
Add all changes
add -p
Add changes interactively
branch current
Show current branch
branch che

data.title: The Minecraft game score unexpectedly became big business for its composer
data.author: tunapizza
data.article_summary: 文章讲述了作曲家Daniel Rosenfeld（艺名C418）为独立游戏《Minecraft》创作音乐的经历。2009年，19岁的Rosenfeld在工厂工作之余为《Minecraft》创作了配乐，当时只收到了少量报酬，但保留了配乐的全部版权。随着《Minecraft》大获成功，微软在2014年收购了开发商Mojang，Rosenfeld拒绝了微软购买其配乐的提议。他与经理Patrick McDermott合作，继续独立管理《Minecraft》相关音乐，并取得了显著成绩，包括金唱片认证和国会图书馆收录。虽然Rosenfeld因此可能失去了为《Minecraft》未来作品创作的机会，但他认为自己的选择是正确的，可以追求其他令他兴奋的音乐项目。文章还探讨了游戏配乐行业的特殊性以及音乐与游戏的跨界潜力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Minecraft音乐及其影响

不同观点：
• [n20benn] 推荐 C418 为 Wanderstop 制作的新专辑，认为它延续了 Minecraft 音乐的风格，甚至更喜欢这张新专辑，并给出推荐曲目。
• [pityJuke] 强调 Minecraft 原声带的强大情感影响力，特别是 "Mice on Venus" 混音版，并提到该音乐常用于 Technoblade 纪念视频中，引发情感共鸣。
• [beAbU] 回忆 C418 的 "Minecraft" 歌曲和游戏中骷髅的声音深深刻在脑海中，尽管多年未玩游戏，但这些声音和音乐依然清晰。
• [donatj] 对微软引入新作曲家的做法表示不满，认为这是对游戏音乐核心魅力的放弃，并强调原作曲家的重要性。
• [chrisdalke] 认为 Minecraft 音乐具有怀旧和深刻的个人意义，不仅是童年记忆的一部分，也是工作和专注时的优质背景音乐，并推荐 "Sweden" 和 "Aria Math" 曲目。
• [rollcat] 认可后期加入的作曲家如 Lena Raine 的作品，特别提到 "Pigstep" 音乐碟在速度跑（speedrun）社区的受欢迎程度。

补充讨论：
• [bearjaws] 提到 C418 通过 Spotify 和 YouTube 获得的收入，猜测微软收购 Minecraft 音乐版权可能与确保 IP 完全拥有权有关。
• [neko_ranger] 简单表达对 "Sweden" 曲目的喜爱。
• [Deeksha676] 分享非付费墙版本的文章链接，方便其他人阅读，解决 [neonate] 提到的付费文章分享问题。

争议焦点：
• 微软引入新作曲家的决定引发部分玩家不满（[donatj]），而另一部分玩家则接受并欣赏新作曲家的作品（[rollcat]）。

44581725.article_content:
Daniel Rosenfeld and Patrick McDermott
Phoebe Wilson
I
n 2009, in between full-time shifts at a local factory, then-19-year-old musician
Daniel Rosenfeld
composed a score for an independent video game. “It was just a side hustle, maybe not even that. It was a hobby, really,” explains Rosenfeld, who records under the name
C418
.
Related
Jack Black Teams With Dave Grohl For Rocking ‘Minecraft’ Soundtrack Song ‘I Feel Alive…
03/24/2025
The game,
Minecraft
, turned out to be successful beyond Rosenfeld’s wildest dreams. In 2014, Microsoft purchased
Minecraft’s
Swedish developer, Mojang Studios, for $2.5 billion, and through 2023, it had sold 300 million copies of the game, making it the best-selling video game of all time. Now, it’s the latest one to receive a movie adaption, and even that has been wildly successful:
A Minecraft Movie,
starring
Jack Black
, is the biggest box office hit of 2025 to date, having already grossed $550.6 million since it opened on April 4.
Because no one anticipated the game’s whirlwind success, or had the budget to properly pay him back in 2009, Rosenfeld was compensated for his work with a small fee and 100% ownership over
Minecraft
’s now-iconic score. Then, when Microsoft came calling, Rosenfeld made a fateful decision: he refused to sell the score to the tech behemoth, opting instead to bring on game composer manager
Patrick McDermott
to help him navigate building a business as an independent composer of
Minecraft
.
Trending on Billboard
McDermott counts himself as one of the rare folks who understands how to navigate both games and music. He started his career at Captured Tracks, and from 2015 to 2020 he built Ghost Ramp, a label which specialized in releasing game soundtracks on vinyl. At the time he was brought in to help Rosenfeld, he was also managing a number of other games composers, too.
Though McDermott says deals like Rosenfeld’s, where composers retain ownership of their IP, are increasingly rare, his
Minecraft
soundtracks have proven to be big business. The score,
Minecraft Volume Alpha,
which is distributed via TuneCore, was certified gold by the RIAA in 2023, and this month, it was inducted into the Library of Congress by the National Recording Registry, which cited it as an “audio treasure worthy of preservation.”
Related
C418 Hits No. 1 on Emerging Artists Chart Thanks to ‘Minecraft: Volume…
08/03/2023
Since its release on digital service providers, streams of
Minecraft Volume Alpha
and its companion
Volume Beta
have averaged 38% year over year growth, and they have been streamed 2.8 billion times worldwide, according to McDermott. McDermott and Rosenfeld have built a surprisingly formidable vinyl business, too. The album, distributed by Ghostly, has sold over 200,000 units to date globally. Rosenfeld even has fans of his own who often congregate in a Discord server devoted to talking about his work, which includes the scores for other games such as
Catacomb Snatch
and
Wanderstop
.
But it’s not all fun and games for Rosenfeld. He thinks that by not selling the score to Microsoft, he might have sacrificed his chance to make future soundtracks for the
Minecraft
franchise — and it’s true that since he declined Microsoft’s offer once and for all, Rosenfeld has not written anything for the game, with Microsoft instead turning to other composers. But because many
Minecraft
players are nostalgic for his original soundtrack, the score for
A Minecraft Movie
, composed by
Devo
’s
Mark Mothersbaugh
, interpolates it — giving Rosenfeld some upside from the blockbuster’s success.
In the end, Rosenfeld feels he made the right choice. “I don’t want to be stuck with the same thing for the next 50 years,” he says of
Minecraft
, and now, he can turn his attention to the new scoring gigs that excite him.
Here, Rosenfeld and McDermott speak to
Billboard
about the strange business of scoring for games and building a living off of
Minecraft.
“I know it’s hard to believe, but there’s a real argument that Daniel’s music is up there for the most heard audio by humans in history,” says McDermott.
Related
The Crossover Potential Between Music & Gaming Is Clear – But It Requires a Thoughtful Approach…
06/08/2023
How were you compensated for the original
Minecraft
game?
Daniel Rosenfeld:
I asked for a share of the game, and I didn’t get a share. I got a tiny, tiny amount of salary for the music itself. The good thing, though, is that I owned the rights to the music, and that’s still persistent to this day. At the time, like 2010, people liked doing [revenue] shares for indie games as payment — like the musician gets 10 percent [of the game’s IP], the visual artist gets 20, and then the main developer gets 40 or whatever. That’s usually what happened back then. Mine was a little different.
Back in the day, when you made this score, is this also how larger game scores worked? Would Nintendo, for example, offer a deal like this?

skip to main
|
skip to sidebar
David Weiss
19 April 2006
A Tour of Microsoft's Mac Lab
Today I'll stop my
3rd person
perspective
. I'm going to write a little bit more about what I do to help MacBU ship great software and provide some color around what's it's like to work on Mac software at Microsoft. Often when we have press events or special visits from our MVPs I'll give them a tour of the Mac Lab and explain what we do. They've always found it very interesting and so I thought I'd share a virtual tour of our Mac Lab. Let's get started:
Lab Door
We start with the door. The Mac Lab is about 2000 square feet of solid computers. The calendars you see down the side of the wall we use to mark team birthdays as well as special events. The CD on the door is an old Apple Software Restore CD from the last beige Mac Apple produced, the Power Macintosh G3.
The "Sandbox" and Plasma display
The first area in the Mac Lab is what we call the Sandbox. This is where we keep all significant hardware configurations Apple has released that run our products. We'll use the Plasma display to, watch DVDs and play games, uh er, I mean, do important training presentations. ;-) It's actually very useful because everyone can be in front of a computer and still see the main screen and follow along. Often other groups at Microsoft (the games group, hardware drivers group and even the Windows media group) will come and schedule time in the Mac Lab to test their software on the different hardware configurations.
Old iMacs and iBooks in the distance
More Macs
We have lots of Apple hardware. You can see here the old colorful iMacs along with some of the old iBooks. You can also see two of our Lab Technicians working on the backup systems, but more about that later. Up until a few months ago we had every significant hardware revision Apple has ever released since the dawn of time. We even had a section of the Lab we affectionately called the "Mac Nursery" where we kept all the older Macs going. We even had an old SE/30 and IIci and super expensive Mac II all connected via PhoneNet running
Spectre
, just for fun. It's always super fun to boot Word 1.0 or Excel 1.0 on these old machines and see how much things have changed. Due to lack of space in the Lab we had to put all of these older machines into storage and recycled the following:
Macintosh (original)
Macintosh SE
Macintosh SE/30
Macintosh Classic
Macintosh Centris 610 <-- I had this one in my room during high school
Macintosh IIci
Macintosh IIsi
Power Macintosh 7100/66
Power Macintosh 7100/80
Power Macintosh 7500/100
Quadra 650
Power Macintosh G3
Duo Dock with Powerbook Duo 2300c
Power Computing PowerCenter Pro 210
May they rest in peace.
ADIC Backup Robots
One of the realities of working with computers is that things fail. More often then you might think. We've used different backup robots, but ever since we moved to ADIC we've never had a robot failure. They just make great stuff. We have 3 robots and use
Veritas Backup Exec
. It works pretty well, as you can see:
Lots of backup tapes
We also do offsite backups just incase "The Big One" hits, but for regular use these tapes work just great, except when they don't. Recently we had a failure and lost 400 GB of data! We restored it from the tapes and then discovered that the Mac version of the Backup Exec agent had a corruption bug causing the restores to be compromised! Veritas folk were super responsive and they should have a new Mac agent out soon. Backup software and file systems are in the class of software that simply must work, all the time. Alas,
this is not always the case
.
I'm going to skip the "Build Lab" section of our Lab since it's very much in
transition
. Maybe I'll post about that later. For now, on to our automation system!
Mac Office is one of those "software in the large" projects. There's really no way a team of our size would be able to adequately test all of Office without the use of automated testing. Every day we get a new build of Office from the build machines, we copy it to our Xserve RAID connected to our dual G5 Xserve for access by our 249 automation machines. We then run thousands and thousands of tests on the new build. Typically we get 4 builds of Office each day: English Ship, English Debug, Japanese Ship and Japanese Debug. We run our entire battery of tests against all the builds and then report any failures to testers via email. The testers investigate the failures, log any bugs and then move on to their other duties as testers. This turns out to be very effective, if used properly, and over time it allows testers to focus on things humans do best, while letting computers verify the repetitious and mundane, but necessary, testing. It all started with our Blue and White G3s years ago. At first when testers would upgrade their test machines, instead of recycling the machines, "The Lab" would get them to add them to our automation machine pool. I think we had about 20 machines to begin with.
Venerab

data.title: Robot metabolism: Toward machines that can grow by consuming other machines
data.author: XzetaU8
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：机器人代谢与自我生长的可行性和限制

不同观点：
• poulpy123认为机器人代谢必须依赖其自身能力完成生长，不能依赖外部系统的主动物理支持，且代谢的唯一外部供给应是能量和以机器人或机器人部件形式存在的物质。这被认为是非常受限的，并与外部支持的观点相矛盾。

• chmod775质疑这种机器人生物在地球上的可行性，认为如果可能，类似生命形式应已进化出来。并指出在地球环境中，碳基生命由于其分子复杂性和多功能性，远胜于硅基系统，即便现代CPU的复杂性也无法与之相比。

• datameta以幽默方式提出，只要有足够的“回形针”作为基础资源，这种系统就能运作，暗示了对这种理论模型可行性的怀疑。

• gavinray引用《Mortal Engines》系列科幻小说，描述了一个后末日世界中的移动城市机器，通过吞噬其他城市来生存，以此类比讨论中的机器人代谢概念，带有一定的文学联想性质。

• omneity质疑所谓的“生长”是否真的属于生长，还是更类似于珊瑚群落的群体组装行为，提出了对生长定义的讨论。

• targetx借用流行文化（Horizon Zero Dawn游戏），表达了对科学家过于关注技术实现而忽视伦理和后果的担忧。

• littlestymaar引用经典台词，强调科学家往往只关注技术可行性，而忽略是否应该去做，反映了技术伦理和责任的思考。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及了技术可行性与伦理问题，部分评论者对机器人自我生长技术表示担忧和质疑。
• 对生长定义的讨论引发了对机器人生物本质理解的争议，部分评论者认为这可能只是一种组装过程而非真正的生长。
• 部分评论带有幽默和文学联想性质，但仍反映了对技术发展和伦理边界的深层次思考。

data.title: Digital vassals? French Government ‘exposes citizens’ data to US'
data.author: ColinWright
data.article_summary: 法国参议院在一份报告中批评政府及公共部门过度依赖美国科技巨头，如微软，称此举威胁国家数字主权，可能导致“主权自杀”。报告指出，法国将关键数据基础设施外包给受美国域外法律管辖的公司，使公共数据暴露于美国监控之下，特别是根据《外国情报监视法》（FISA）和《澄清合法海外数据使用法》（CLOUD）。微软法务总监承认无法保证法国数据不会被交给外国当局。参议院还指责政府贬低欧洲替代方案，过于关注价格而忽视法律和战略风险。与此同时，其他欧洲国家如丹麦已开始减少对美国科技公司的依赖。法国议员呼吁欧盟暂停与美国的隐私保护协议，以应对主权风险。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：欧洲在数据主权、IT基础设施选择以及对美国科技巨头的依赖方面的讨论和争议

不同观点：
• Saline9515认为，法国政府选择微软产品并非出于成本或效率考虑，而是因为政府人员对微软的依赖以及不愿学习新工具。他还分享了个人经历，表明在试图转向开源软件R或Python时遇到了内部抵制。
• mananaysiempre关注数据收集量的问题，认为减少数据收集是关键，因为即使数据在一个司法管辖区内，也可能成为攻击目标。
• afarah1引用了CJEU的裁决，指出美国在隐私问题上的立场与欧盟法律不兼容，并对欧盟委员会一再认可与美国的协议表示质疑。
• ColinWright分享了一段法国参议院的会议记录，显示微软法国代表无法保证法国公民的数据不会被美国政府传唤。
• crop_rotation批评欧盟没有建立本土软件生态系统，并指出中国在这方面的优势。
• phtrivier指出法国和欧盟内部开始出现对数据主权和减少对美国依赖的讨论，但实际进展缓慢。
• isodev建议对涉及美国科技公司的产品应有更透明的披露和警告。
• CalRobert提到欧洲对微软Azure的依赖令人费解。
• reestr认为，数据基础设施的控制权比平台的所有权更重要，一旦暴露结构中，主权就成为一种错觉。
• hollowonepl质疑美国设备与中国的设备在监听方面是否有本质区别。
• SpicyLemonZest指出，数字主权需要强大的本土软件产业支持，并提到欧洲解决方案常被误认为成本过高或效率低下。
• MEMORYC_RRUPTED分享了比利时和荷兰的情况，指出政府部门对微软系统的依赖以及转型困难。
• stef25对讨论的网站提出质疑，认为其有亲俄罗斯倾向，并提供了相关背景资料。
• bpavuk提到法国尝试通过Mistral和La Suite来引领数据主权，但对其实施情况表示疑惑。
• rdm_blackhole总结了从美国科技巨头转型的困难，指出无论是转向开源软件还是开发本土解决方案，都需要大量时间和成本，而欧盟在这方面已经落后。

补充讨论：
• 数据主权和隐私保护的争议焦点在于欧盟与美国之间的法律和协议不兼容性，以及美国政府可能通过法律手段获取欧盟公民数据。
• 欧洲在建立自主IT基础设施和软件生态系统方面面临巨大挑战，包括技术转型难度、成本问题以及政治和经济利益的牵扯。
• 对数据收集和监控的广泛关注，反映了公众和政府在数字化时代对隐私和安全的日益重视。
• 对讨论平台和信息来源的质疑反映了信息可信度和潜在政治倾向在公共讨论中的重要性。

The French Senate slams the French governement and public services deepening reliance on American tech giants, warning of a looming “sovereignty suicide". Getty
News
16 July 2025
Digital vassals? French Government ‘exposes citizens’ data to US’
Anne-Laure Dufeal
Share
France’s deepening reliance on US tech giants is raising alarms about digital sovereignty and exposing public data to foreign jurisdictions.
In a French Senate report on economic and digital sovereignty, Senators accused the French State of “political fault”. That was in regard to outsourcing essential data infrastructure to US companies subject to US extraterritorial laws, including
Microsoft
, despite repeated warnings and alternatives.
“France is subject to US extraterritorial law,” the report stated, warning that public data, including from health, education and critical sectors, was exposed to foreign surveillance under US legislation such as the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA) and the Clarifying Lawful Overseas Use of Data Act (CLOUD).
This legislation allowed the US Government to demand that companies subject to US law disclose the data they stored, simply by obtaining a judge’s authorisation.
The Senate report cited Microsoft France’s legal director, Anton Carniaux, as admitting the company could not guarantee that French data it hosted would not be handed over to foreign authorities.
“Carniaux … was asked by the [French Senate] commission to guarantee that French citizens’ data hosted by Microsoft would never be transmitted to foreign authorities without the agreement of the French authorities. He replied: ‘No, I can’t guarantee that,'” the report stated.
US tech giant Microsoft presented new plans promising to improve the European cloud customers’ data protection.
https://t.co/lkX1ysk1vy
— Brussels Signal (@brusselssignal)
June 18, 2025
In March 2025, the Ministry of Education signed a €74 million deal with a US company for equipping its departments and universities.
The country’s elite school for engineers, École Polytechnique, also decided earlier this year to move the school’s IT system to Microsoft.
That was done despite earlier instructions from the French Government urging school districts to avoid deploying Microsoft or Google collaborative tools due to sovereignty risks.
The CNLL (National Council for Free Software) warned that “legal, technical, and strategic risks are being deliberately ignored.”
Speaking with
Brussels Signal
on July 16, French MP Philippe Latombe blames France’s “bureaucratic inertia”.
“There is no real connection between political leaders and French civil servants, who think they will remain in their posts indefinitely. This creates bureaucratic inertia. They secured early contracts easily because they have always been there, which leads to habitual reliance by public buyers,” he said.
In their report, the French Senate accused the government of systematically discrediting European alternatives, claiming they were “too costly” or “not efficient enough”.
“The commission of inquiry found that European solutions were systematically denigrated by the government, wrongly judged to be too costly or inefficient,” the report read.
For Latombe, France needs to move beyond price, and consider other factors like the fact that French companies contribute to the national social system, such as social security contributions, taxes.
French MP Philippe Latombe has urged European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen to suspend the US-EU Data Privacy Framework before President-elect Donald Trump assumes office.
https://t.co/ni5C4rYxxW
— Brussels Signal (@brusselssignal)
November 15, 2024
In November last year,
Latombe criticised
the US-EU Data Privacy Framework (DPF) deal, saying it no longer served EU interests due to the US president’s “impulsive” nature.
The DPF was designed to make it easier for companies to transfer personal data such as names, addresses and browsing history from the EU to the US.
Another striking example comes from the cybersecurity sector.
In early 2025, the French cybersecurity firm VADE merged with Germany’s Hornet Security, forming what appeared to be a promising EU-based leader in international cloud security. However, just a year later, in March 2025, US company Proofpoint acquired the entire Hornetsecurity Group.
“As a result, there is no longer a fully French solution in this strategic sector”, denounced Latombe.
Tech giant Meta has snubbed a ‘cease and desist’ request from the European digital rights watchdog over their use of personal data to train AI systems.
https://t.co/tvtJr51KkD
— Brussels Signal (@brusselssignal)
May 15, 2025
While France deepened its digital dependency, other European nations have been pushing back.

data.title: Java was not underhyped in 1997 (2021)
data.author: SerCe
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了Java在1997年时的巨大影响力以及其后来为何失去关注。作者Dylan Beattie回忆了1997年他在大学学习计算机科学时，Java是必修课，并且被广泛应用于各种课程中。Java在当时因其自动垃圾回收、并发处理、异常处理等创新特性备受推崇，甚至被认为能解决所有问题，取代桌面应用和微软Windows系统。Corel等公司曾计划将重要软件移植到Java平台，Java applets被视为网络应用的未来。然而，Java的实际表现不如预期，在桌面应用和游戏开发方面不如Visual Basic、C++，而在服务器端网络编程方面则面临Perl、PHP等竞争。Java虽好，但并未能如 hype 所预期的那样彻底改变计算机世界。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Java的“ hype”（炒作）历史及其技术能力和市场影响

不同观点：
• **Java的技术能力被低估 vs. 过度炒作的市场表现**：
  - **技术能力被低估**：Jackson Roberts的文章认为Java在技术能力（如类型系统和包管理器）方面没有被充分认识和利用，因此是“低估”了。
  - **市场过度炒作**：jasode和jerf指出1990年代对Java的炒作过于夸张，例如“Write Once, Run Anywhere”和取代C/C++等预言并未实现。

• **Sun对Java的教育和市场策略**：
  - **vanschelven**认为Sun通过学术授权和广告投入，有计划地将Java推广到大学教育中，这是其成功的重要因素。
  - **bane**补充，Java通过降低开发成本和简化企业开发流程，满足了企业软件开发的需求，尤其是在成本控制和自动化业务流程方面。

• **Java在企业开发中的优缺点**：
  - **优点**：bane指出Java的生态系统和跨平台能力使其在企业开发中具有优势，尤其是在降低总拥有成本（TCO）方面。
  - **缺点**：rr808和liampulles批评Java企业开发中的复杂性，尤其是Spring IoC容器带来的“魔法”代码，使得理解和维护变得困难。

• **Java的历史影响和现状**：
  - **持久的影响力**：lordleft和jmyeet认为Java在企业界和大型科技公司中的广泛应用证明了其稳健性和实用性，Java对技术发展的民主化起到了重要作用。
  - **过度炒作的教训**：stephenlf和basfo提到Java的炒作和现实之间的差距，并将其与当前的AI炒作进行对比。

补充讨论：
• **Java的技术局限**：binarymax指出Java缺乏对无符号数值的原生支持，这是一个技术上的不足。
• **历史背景的复杂性**：w10-1详细描述了Java在不同公司和产品之间的商业竞争和合作，如Sun、Microsoft和IBM，揭示了Java生态系统中的复杂商业关系。

争议焦点：
• **Java是否被过度炒作**：一方认为Java在1990年代被过度炒作，未能实现许多预言；另一方则认为Java在技术上有其独特优势，只是市场预期过高。
• **企业开发中的复杂性**：一些开发者批评Java企业开发框架（如Spring）的复杂性和“魔法”代码，而另一些则认为Java的生态系统和跨平台能力使其在企业开发中具有不可替代的优势。

44590034.article_content:
Java Criminally Underhyped? Not Back in 1997.
Posted by
Dylan Beattie
on
01 July 2021
•
permalink
Earlier today, a fun little moment of
Twitter serendipity
alerted me to an article by Jackson Roberts, a computer science student at the University of Colorado, entitled “
Java is criminally underhyped
”. It’s a really interesting article, and Jackson’s observations correlate with a lot of my own thinking about languages and platforms, although I am squarely in the .NET / CLR camp on that particular front.
But Jackson ends his article:
I am curious why Java lost its hype in the first place. Programmer culture history is poorly documented and if you have insight, please
email me
or leave a comment.
And, well, the comment I was leaving got a bit long, so I figured I’d blog about it instead. You see, I studied computer science at the University of Southampton, from 1997 to 2000, and when I was an undergraduate, the hype about Java was unbelievable. Java was too important to ignore; it was released in January 1996, and by the time I started university in September 1997 it was a mandatory course for all first year students; it was used throughout my degree course, right up to the final year module on programming language design where our coursework assignment was to build a Scheme interpreter – in Java.
Java circa 1997 was probably the most hyped thing I have ever seen in my career.
For starters, it was the first really mainstream language to introduce a lot of features we now take for granted in most high-level languages. Memory management? Readers, even to a first-year comp sci undergraduate who had spent a grand total of six weeks working with
malloc
and
free
, Java’s automatic garbage collection was clearly a revelation. Concurrency? It has threads. They work. Job done. Exceptions? You mean I can just write functions that return what I want, instead of functions that leave the result in a
char*
pointer somewhere and return an arbitrary non-zero integer if it worked? Java introduced a lot of incredibly powerful ideas and patterns, and it’s hard to underestimate how much impact it would have on the next two decades of programming language design.
But Java wasn’t content with that. Java was going to solve ALL the problems. JavaScript? The language that would end up taking over the world wide web? JavaScript was a glue language. The idea was that all your
serious
applications would be deployed as Java applets, with JavaScript used for only the most superficial wiring between applets. Java applets were such a big deal in 1997 that some people seriously believed that they represented the end of desktop applications, the end of Microsoft Windows; even the end of the computer as we knew it.
Corel, who at the time were still a credible threat to Microsoft’s emerging monopoly, announced in 1996 that they were porting their WordPerfect office suite and their market-leading CorelDRAW! graphics software to Java. Check out
this Infoworld article from 1996
to see just how deep the hype hole really went:
“The success of Java-based network computers, and perhaps Java itself, will likely require the availability of vertical productivity applications for word processing, spreadsheets and databases. At the JavaOne conference, Corel Corp. (www.corel.com) made a first stab at offering such products with the announcement that it plans to deliver a suite of office applications based on its QuattroPro and WordPerfect products. Both products should be available for sale by early next year.”
Java was going to revolutionise desktop development: Java Swing and the Java Native Interface (JNI) meant you could write your app once, and run it on Windows, Linux and Solaris.
1
And thanks to the amazing power of JavaBeans, once you had implemented a particular service or algorithm, you could create a “bean” for it and it could be reused anywhere, by anybody, and building software would be as easy as putting together Lego bricks. JavaBeans were often cited as the last component model we would ever need.
There was an industry spec for a “
Network Computer
”, a device profile that mandated support for HTTP, Java, JPEG and a handful of other standards… hardware companies would build and sell Network Computers, developers would use Java’s “write once, run anywhere” model to build software for Network Computers, and the entire future would be Java applets running on set-top boxes (or “net-top boxes” as they were often dubbed.) Sun Microsystems actually shipped a thing called the JavaStation, a device based on their SPARCstation platform that ran JavaOS.
The problem is: Java was good, but it wasn’t
that
good. For Windows desktop apps, Visual Basic and Visual C++ could run rings around it. For games and anything where performance was a consideration, C++ all the way, especially as we entered an age of affordable 3D graphics cards and OpenGL became a big deal. And for server-side web programming, we had Perl, PHP, Microsoft Active Server Pages, and good ol

data.title: Laminar Flow Airfoil
data.author: colinprince
data.article_summary:
文章主要介绍了层流翼型及其在航空领域的应用。层流是指空气在飞机机翼或机身表面平滑、无干扰地流动，对飞行至关重要。如果流动被中断，会产生湍流，导致升力下降和阻力增加。层流翼型设计旨在保持边界层的平滑流动，以减少阻力。

北美P-51“野马”战斗机是首款有意采用层流翼型的飞机，但由于制造表面不够光滑，实际层流效果有限。贝尔P-63“眼镜王蛇”也有类似问题。层流理论可追溯到德国空气动力学家路德维希·普朗特的研究，他提出了边界层的概念。

尽管“ consolidated B-24解放者”的“戴维斯”翼型早于P-51就具有低阻力特性，但设计者并未意识到它是层流翼型。NACA在20世纪30年代末对一些飞机进行了层流翼型测试，如改装的B-18。

层流翼型的应用需要极高的表面光滑度，这在批量生产中难以实现。北美航空通过填充和涂漆来解决这一问题，以提供必要的平滑度。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同飞机设计中的层流翼、气动特性及其在实际飞行中的表现和问题

不同观点：
• **satiated_grue** 提到Rutan Vari-Eze飞机的层流前翼在受到虫污污染后会导致飞机变得头重，影响飞行特性。一些机主通过安装微型涡流发生器来缓解问题，但这也可能改变气动设计，导致主翼先失速，进而引发深失速风险。涡流发生器虽然能保持飞行稳定性，但可能带来安全隐患。

• **upofadown** 分享了滑翔机上存在的类似问题，提到一个标有“BUGS”的切换开关，用来应对虫污对翼面层流的影响。这种问题会导致滑翔机的性能下降，尤其是在最后滑翔阶段，飞行计算机需要调整参数以确保正确计算。

• **K0balt** 介绍了自己驾驶Aero Commander 100 "Darter"的体验，这款飞机采用了层流光滑翼型和纤维玻璃弹簧起落架，油耗效率比Cessna 172有所改善。但其层流翼在地面效应和起飞加速方面表现不佳，且失速特性较为突然，尽管飞机整体操控性良好。

• **ks1723** 强调了即便在2000年代，层流翼技术仍有创新空间，特别是在商务喷气机上的应用，如本田飞机公司的HondaJet，展示了层流技术在现代航空器中的持续发展潜力。

补充讨论：
• 层流翼在理想状态下能够提升空气动力效率，但容易受到外部因素（如虫污）的影响，导致性能下降。
• 涡流发生器的使用在解决层流问题的同时，可能会引入新的气动风险，尤其是在失速特性改变的情况下。
• 不同飞机类型（如Rutan Vari-Eze、Aero Commander 100、HondaJet）在层流技术应用上的实际表现各有不同，反映了设计和使用场景的复杂性。
• 飞行计算机在现代滑翔机中起到了调整飞行参数的作用，帮助应对层流受干扰带来的性能下降问题。

争议焦点：
• 涡流发生器的使用是否会改变飞机的失速特性，从而带来安全隐患，特别是可能导致深失速的情况。

44600043.article_content:
Laminar Flow Airfoil
Laminar Flow
is the smooth, uninterrupted flow of
air over the contour of the wings, fuselage, or other
parts of an aircraft in flight. Laminar flow is most
often found at the front of a streamlined body and is
an important factor in flight. If the smooth flow of
air is interrupted over a wing section, turbulence is
created which results in a loss of
lift
and a high
degree of drag. An airfoil designed for minimum
drag
and uninterrupted flow of the boundary layer is called
a laminar airfoil.
The Laminar flow theory dealt with the development
of a symmetrical airfoil section which had the same
curvature on both the upper and lower surface. The
design was relatively thin at the leading edge and progressively
widened to a point of greatest thickness as
far aft as possible. The theory in using an airfoil of
this design was to maintain the adhesion of the boundary layers of
airflow which are present in flight as far
aft of the leading edge as possible. On normal airfoils,
the boundary layer would be interrupted at high speeds
and the resultant break would cause a turbulent flow
over the remainder of the foil. This turbulence would
be realized as drag up the point of maximum speed, at
which time the control surfaces and aircraft flying
characteristics would be affected. The formation of the
boundary layer is a process of layers of air formed
one next to the other, i.e.; the term laminar is derived
from the lamination principle involved.
The History of Laminar Flow
The
North American P-51 Mustang
was the first aircraft intentionally
designed to use laminar flow airfoils.  However, wartime National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics (NACA) research
data shows that Mustangs were not manufactured with a sufficient
degree of surface quality to maintain much laminar flow on the wing.  The
Royal Air Force (RAF) found that the
Bell P-63 Kingcobra
, despite being designed with laminar airfoils,
also was not manufactured with sufficient surface quality to have much
laminar flow.
The
Mustang
was a mathematically designed airplane
and the wing foil that was to be classified as a
"semi-empirical venture" by the British was cleared for
adoption on the new design. The wing section would
be the only part of the fighter which would be tested
in a wind tunnel prior to the first test flight. Due to the
speculation of the success of the radical foil, the engineering
department was committed to adopt a more
conventional airfoil within thirty days of the tests in
the event the wing did not come up to specifications.
A one quarter scale model of the wing was designed
and constructed for tests in the wing tunnel at the
California Institute of Technology.
The use of this airfoil on the
Mustang
would greatly
add to the drag reducing concept that was paramount
in all design phases of the airplane. The few applications
of this foil, prior to this time, had been handbuilt
structures which were finished to exacting
tolerances. An absolutely smooth surface was necessary
due to the fact that any surface break or rough
protrusion would interrupt the airflow and detract from
the laminar flow theory. Because of the exactness
required, the foil had been shelved by other manufacturers
due to the clearances and tolerances which are
used in mass production. The engineers at North American Aviation (NAA)
approached this problem with a plan to fill and paint
the wing surface to provide the necessary smoothness.
The foil which was used for the Mustang had a
thickness ratio of 15.1 percent at the wing root at 39

pressure gradient over the leading 50-60 percent
of the wing surface.

44600043.article_summary:
文章主要介绍了层流翼型及其在航空领域的应用。层流是指空气在飞机机翼或机身表面平滑、无干扰地流动，对飞行至关重要。如果流动被中断，会产生湍流，导致升力下降和阻力增加。层流翼型设计旨在保持边界层的平滑流动，以减少阻力。

北美P-51“野马”战斗机是首款有意采用层流翼型的飞机，但由于制造表面不够光滑，实际层流效果有限。贝尔P-63“眼镜王蛇”也有类似问题。层流理论可追溯到德国空气动力学家路德维希·普朗特的研究，他提出了边界层的概念。

尽管“ consolidated B-24解放者”的“戴维斯”翼型早于P-51就具有低阻力特性，但设计者并未意识到它是层流翼型。NACA在20世纪30年代末对一些飞机进行了层流翼型测试，如改装的B-18。

层流翼型的应用需要极高的表面光滑度，这在批量生产中难以实现。北美航空通过填充和涂漆来解决这一问题，以提供必要的平滑度。
44600043.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同飞机设计中的层流翼、气动特性及其在实际飞行中的表现和问题

不同观点：
• **satiated_grue** 提到Rutan Vari-Eze飞机的层流前翼在受到虫污污染后会导致飞机变得头重，影响飞行特性。一些机主通过安装微型涡流发生器来缓解问题，但这也可能改变气动设计，导致主翼先失速，进而引发深失速风险。涡流发生器虽然能保持飞行稳定性，但可能带来安全隐患。

• **upofadown** 分享了滑翔机上存在的类似问题，提到一个标有“BUGS”的切换开关，用来应对虫污对翼面层流的影响。这种问题会导致滑翔机的性能下降，尤其是在最后滑翔阶段，飞行计算机需要调整参数以确保正确计算。

• **K0balt** 介绍了自己驾驶Aero Commander 100 "Darter"的体验，这款飞机采用了层流光滑翼型和纤维玻璃弹簧起落架，油耗效率比Cessna 172有所改善。但其层流翼在地面效应和起飞加速方面表现不佳，且失速特性较为突然，尽管飞机整体操控性良好。

• **ks1723** 强调了即便在2000年代，层流翼技术仍有创新空间，特别是在商务喷气机上的应用，如本田飞机公司的HondaJet，展示了层流技术在现代航空器中的持续发展潜力。

补充讨论：
• 层流翼在理想状态下能够提升空气动力效率，但容易受到外部因素（如虫污）的影响，导致性能下降。
• 涡流发生器的使用在解决层流问题的同时，可能会引入新的气动风险，尤其是在失速特性改变的情况下。
• 不同飞机类型（如Rutan Vari-Eze、Aero Commander 100、HondaJet）在层流技术应用上的实际表现各有不同，反映了设计和使用场景的复杂性。
• 飞行计算机在现代滑翔机中起到了调整飞行参数的作用，帮助应对层流受干扰带来的性能下降问题。

争议焦点：
• 涡流发生器的使用是否会改变飞机的失速特性，从而带来安全隐患，特别是可能导致深失速的情况。

data.title: JOVE – Jonathan’s Own Version of Emacs
data.author: nanna
data.article_summary: JOVE（Jonathan's Own Version of Emacs）是一款开源的、类似于Emacs的文本编辑器，主要用于Unix-like操作系统，也支持MS-DOS和Microsoft Windows。它由Jonathan Payne于1983年创建，灵感来自Gosling Emacs，但更小巧简单，不支持Mocklisp。JOVE曾随多个BSD Unix版本发布，最新稳定版为4.16，开发版为4.17.4.4。与GNU Emacs不同，JOVE不支持UTF-8编码。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Emacs及其替代品、变种在不同环境下的使用体验与技术探讨，以及对相关人物的评价。

不同观点：
• **Kleiba的观点**：Kleiba讲述了自己在政府部门工作时，由于工作清闲且电脑受限，无法使用自己惯用的Emacs和编程工具。于是尝试用JavaScript（JScript）在Windows机器上开发Emacs的克隆版。这让他在枯燥的工作中找到了乐趣，尽管最终因工作任务增加而暂停开发。Kleiba的经历强调了在受限环境中寻找技术乐趣的体验。

• **Uncircle的观点**：Uncircle对什么是Emacs克隆提出了质疑，提出了几个关键要素，如Lisp的使用、特定的键绑定以及“一切皆缓冲区”的范式。Uncircle的评论引发了对Emacs本质特征的讨论。

• **Purkka和Nanna的观点**：Purkka提到JOVE编辑器不支持UTF-8，并对这一现象表示惊讶。Nanna则表示通过介绍JOVE的文章，发现JOVE是一个比Emacs或Nano更轻便的终端编辑器选择。这反映了部分用户对轻量级编辑器的需求。

• **Jbellis和Sombragris的观点**：Jbellis提到在DOS时代使用的JED编辑器，并惊讶于其仍在维护。Sombragris则表示在Slackware系统上，JOVE是默认安装的，但他个人更偏好JED，认为其比Emacs更友好。这表明不同用户对不同编辑器的偏好和使用体验各有不同。

• **Ridruejo的观点**：Ridruejo认为JOVE和JED是Emacs的轻量替代品，尤其在Emacs过于笨重时。

• **JerrySievert的观点**：JerrySievert分享了自己从早期通过低速连接使用Emacs，到后来在Unix和X11环境下使用XEmacs的经历，最终转向Vi和现代IDE。这展示了用户在不同技术发展阶段对编辑器的选择变化。

• **Ww520的观点**：Ww520提到JOVE是自己首次在Unix上使用的编辑器，因为当时的Emacs过于消耗资源。

• **Fmajid的观点**：Fmajid提醒不要将JOVE与JOVIAL混淆，后者是一种用于美国空中交通控制系统的编程语言。

补充讨论：
• **DonHopkins的观点**：DonHopkins分享了与Jonathan Payne共事的经历，并揭露了Jonathan Payne在社交媒体上的极端言论和仇恨言论行为。这部分评论偏离了技术讨论，转向了对个人行为和品德的评价。

• **Zzzeek的观点**：Zzzeek简短地提到自己在1989年左右使用Emacs的经历，并表示现在更偏好Vi。这反映了个人对编辑器的长期使用偏好变化。

争议焦点：
• **什么是Emacs克隆**：Uncircle对Emacs克隆的定义提出了疑问，引发了对Emacs核心特征的讨论。
• **Jonathan Payne的行为**：DonHopkins对Jonathan Payne的极端言论和仇恨言论进行了揭露和谴责，这涉及到个人品德和行为评价的争议。

data.title: Simulating hand-drawn motion with SVG filters
data.author: camillovisini
data.article_summary:
本文介绍了一种使用SVG滤镜和JavaScript实现手绘抖动动画效果的实用指南，称为“boiling line”效果。这种效果常用于卡通动画，通过轻微变形和循环播放，使静态图像看起来像在微微移动。文章分解了实现该效果的两个主要步骤：

1. **边缘扭曲**：使用SVG滤镜`feTurbulence`和`feDisplacementMap`来生成噪声纹理并扭曲形状边缘，使其看起来不那么规则。
2. **动画效果**：通过JavaScript定期更新这些滤镜参数，实现动态变化，使静态图像更具动感。

文章还提供了一个代码示例，展示了如何设置SVG滤镜效果以实现这种扭曲动画。这种方法可以在网页上模拟手绘动画的抖动效果，增加视觉吸引力。

44591305.article_content:
Simulating Hand-Drawn Motion with SVG Filters
A practical guide to implementing the boiling line animation effect using SVG filter primitives and JavaScript
Published on
July 09, 2025
Ever wondered how cartoons create that hand-drawn “jitter” effect? I recently watched an
ARTE documentary
about Neapolitan pizza and was fascinated by the animated illustrations (drawn in simple shapes and plain colors) that accompanied the
segment
where the recipe and its ingredients were presented. The illustrations were static, but they had a subtle animation effect that made them look like they were moving slightly.
See for example in this short clip, where you can see the ingredients being presented (pay attention to the edges of the shapes):
Animated illustration of ingredients for Pizza Napoli - Source: ARTE
I was curious to find out how this effect might have been achieved. First, I had to find out what it was called – turns out that this specific effect is actually quite common in cartoon-style animations and illustrations.
After some research, I found out that this effect is called
“boiling”
or
line boil
and was traditionally achieved by drawing the same frame multiple times in a row, with slight variations in position and rotation. This creates the illusion of movement in an otherwise static scene. The technique is often used in animation to create a more dynamic and engaging visual experience (instead of just a static image or scene, for example when a character is standing still).
Let’s take a look at a simple example of this effect in the demo below. I have traced the same object multiple times. Naturally, as these drawings are tracings by hand and not perfect copies, there are subtle differences between them. But, this becomes only apparent when the drawings are overlaid and animated!
When looking closely at the initial short clip, you will notice that the effect is more of a trick. There seems to be a layer of a rough paper-like texture with some kind of overlay effect that is applied to the whole scene, giving it a dynamic quality. That’s not the part we will focus on, though.
More interestingly, the edges of the shapes seem to wobble slightly and appear gritty or sketch-like, as if they were drawn by hand. But are they drawn by hand, as in my demo above? I don’t think that’s the case, because the contours are wobbling “in a loop”. Or in other words: The boiling effect is somehow achieved artificially: Rather than by drawing the same frame multiple times with slight variations, it seems to be a post-processing effect applied to the static illustrations, which were likely drawn as “perfect” shapes.
This blog post describes my attempt to recreate this effect in a simple way and bring it to the web. Let’s dive in.
Decomposing the effect
To recreate the boiling effect, we can break it down into two main components:
Distorting the edges
: The edges of the shapes should not be perfectly straight, but rather have a slight wobble that gives them a more organic and hand-drawn look. This could be achieved by applying a distortion effect to the edges of the shapes – which could be controlled by a set of parameters.
Animating the effect
: Then, these
distortion parameters
are animated over time (for example, updated with new values every 200 milliseconds), creating a subtle movement that makes an otherwise static scene feel more engaging.
Probably, the second part is intuitive to understand, but the first part is a bit more complex. Because we are trying to create this effect in a web context, we will use
SVG filter effects
for our approach (step 1). What follows is that we can then easily manipulate (and therefore animate) the properties of these filter effects using JavaScript (step 2). But how do these SVG filter effects work, exactly? Let’s take a closer look.
SVG filter effects
SVG filter effects
allow us to apply various visual effects to SVG elements, such as blurring, color manipulation, and distortion. In our case, we will use a combination of the
feTurbulence
and
feDisplacementMap
filter primitives to create the boiling effect.
Conceptually, the
Turbulence Field
generates a noise texture that can be used to distort the edges of the shapes. The
Displacement Map
then uses this noise texture to displace the pixels of the original image, creating the desired distortion effect. See this visualization:
Turbulence + Displacement: How SVG filter effects work together to create the distortion effect
Additionally, I’ve created a demo that let’s you explore the interplay of these two filter effects. You can move the layers to see how the distortion changes at the intersection of the two filter effects. Note: The demo contains some added elements and visual indicators for demo purposes and easier understanding.
The above demo illustrates how the distortion effect is applied to the image. Let’s take a closer look at how to set up the SVG filter effects in terms of code.

本文介绍了一种使用SVG滤镜和JavaScript实现手绘抖动动画效果的实用指南，称为“boiling line”效果。这种效果常用于卡通动画，通过轻微变形和循环播放，使静态图像看起来像在微微移动。文章分解了实现该效果的两个主要步骤：

1. **边缘扭曲**：使用SVG滤镜`feTurbulence`和`feDisplacementMap`来生成噪声纹理并扭曲形状边缘，使其看起来不那么规则。
2. **动画效果**：通过JavaScript定期更新这些滤镜参数，实现动态变化，使静态图像更具动感。

文章还提供了一个代码示例，展示了如何设置SVG滤镜效果以实现这种扭曲动画。这种方法可以在网页上模拟手绘动画的抖动效果，增加视觉吸引力。

data.title: Stdio(3) change: FILE is now opaque
data.author: gslin
data.article_summary: 2025年7月17日，OpenBSD的-current分支中，stdio(3)的FILE类型结构体被设为不透明（opaque），相关库版本也已更新。具体改动包括将__sFILE定义移至libc/hidden/_stdio.h，并暂时保留某些符号以方便过渡，但这些符号将很快被删除。这一重大变更影响了许多系统组件，建议从源代码构建的用户使用快照升级以顺利过渡。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：FreeBSD 中 FILE 类型的非透明性及其相关更改

不同观点：
• **loeg** 提到 FreeBSD 曾尝试将 FILE 类型变为不透明，但更改被回退，目前在主分支中仍为非透明。他提供了相关的代码提交链接以支持其观点。
• **JdeBP** 认为，当对 C 库进行此类更改时，首先应关注 stdin、stdout 和 stderr 的变化，因为这些标准流的历史实现方式可能会导致链接问题。他指出，改变这些标准流可能导致未重新编译的代码无法链接。
• **Cadwhisker** 质疑更改的原因，询问是否出于安全原因或为未来变化做准备，强调好的评论应说明“为什么”。
• **abnercoimbre** 表示自己一直将 FILE 视为不透明类型，但没想到有人会深入探究其内部结构，暗示对 FILE 内部的依赖可能是不好的实践。
• **severino** 引用了 Linux/GNU 中的代码，询问这种定义是否意味着类型是不透明的，提供了具体的代码示例。
• **cperciva** 补充，非不透明 FILE 允许与将 FILE 放入结构中的代码兼容，因为不透明 FILE 没有大小。
• **p0w3n3d** 质疑为何要依赖 FILE 的内部结构，认为这是一种不良实践。
• **xpressvideoz** 对提交信息和公告文章中未提及理由表示不满，认为这种做法令人不安。
• **notepad0x90** 赞赏 *bsd 的勇气，认为它们不惧变化，而 Linux 应从中学习，并指出 Windows 因不愿打破旧有体系而导致的问题。
• **somat** 通过对比 OpenBSD 和 Linux，指出 Linux 在更改 ABI 方面的困难和顾虑，并分析了 Linux 的特殊情况，如闭源软件的支持和项目规模的影响。

补充讨论：
• **quotemstr** 提到 CHERI 可以在无需切换地址空间的情况下防止对内部数据结构的访问，为讨论提供了一种技术解决方案。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于是否应将 FILE 类型设为不透明，以及依赖 FILE 内部结构是否为不良实践。部分参与者认为更改应有明确理由，并对当前做法表示担忧。

Log message:
Make the FILE object opaque.  Move the __sFILE definition into
libc/hidden/_stdio.h.  All programs that refer to the internal
structure of the FILE object can't be compiled from now on.
std{in,out,err} doesn't refer __sF[] now, but the hidden __sF along
with __srget and __swbuf symbols are kept temporarily to make our
transition easier.  But those symbols will be deleted soon.  The shared
library versions are bumped for libc and all the other libraries that
refer to std{in,out,err}.
diff from guenther, tweak by me, tested by many
ok sthen tb
Make no mistake, this is a
major
change, which touches a lot of components across the base system. The fallout can be seen in a lot of places, including
libcrypto
(which is itself subject to a major, sepearate cleanup),
libtls
,
libssl
, and includes touches to the
profiling subsystem
we
mentioned earlier
.
Those who normally build from source are
strongly
encouraged
to use a snapshot upgrade
to cross the bumps.

data.title: Subreply – An open source text-only social network
data.author: lcnmrn
data.article_summary: Subreply是一个小型但功能强大的社交网络。项目代码托管在GitHub上，包含多个文件和目录，如应用配置、数据库迁移脚本、依赖列表等。主要技术栈包括Python、HTML、CSS、Sass和JavaScript。安装步骤包括克隆代码、安装依赖、配置签名密钥和运行迁移。项目强调代码简洁、易读，并要求每个请求的响应速度在50毫秒以内。当前有22个星标，但无发布版本或包。项目官网为subreply.com。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：开源许可证及其影响、社交网络成功要素、用户界面与用户体验、内容审核与言论自由、平台技术细节与功能需求、平台文化和参与度

不同观点：
• **许可证问题**：asjo指出该项目的许可证声明为"All rights reserved"，质疑其是否真正开源。
• **社交网络的成功要素**：grillitoazul认为新社交网络需要有趣的内容和独特的文化，以保持用户参与，并以J编程语言和Hacker News为例。
• **用户界面与用户体验**：bluerooibos认为当前用户界面缺乏对比和层次，建议进行UX改进以提升可读性。
• **技术实现与项目分享**：mariusor提到自己正在开发一个联合链接聚合器，并表示愿意帮助有兴趣的人设置。
• **图像内容的重要性**：PaulHoule指出图像内容能提升参与度，并分享自己在Mastodon和Bluesky上分享照片的乐趣。
• **内容审核与言论自由**：nathan_compton提到在平台上看到不当言论，表达了对内容审核和言论自由之间平衡的困惑。
• **项目历史与开放源代码**：davidcollantes提到早在10年前就请求过该项目的开源。
• **技术建议**：diath建议将依赖库的版本固定在特定版本。
• **密码复杂性问题**：dsmurrell抱怨注册时密码需要小写字母，建议使用基于熵的密码复杂度测量。
• **平台文化和商业化**：giancarlostoro认为文本为主的社交媒体应注重内容质量，并考虑如何正确地进行商业化和广告。
• **算法透明性**：admiralrohan询问时间线算法的细节，特别是哪些帖子会被提升。
• **平台历史**：dorian-graph指出该平台曾用名Sublevel和Superthread。
• **平台活跃度质疑**：Sirikon质疑平台活跃度，指出开发者声称"Mastodon is dead"的帖子只有12个回复。
• **个人参与意愿**：gigatexal表示对平台感兴趣，并提到自己很久没登录Mastodon，也不喜欢回声室效应。

补充讨论：
• 评论中多次提到Mastodon，显示出用户对不同社交平台的比较和迁移意愿。
• 关于内容审核和言论自由的讨论显示出用户对平台文化及社区规范的关注。
• 技术细节如密码复杂性和库版本固定等反映了用户对平台技术实现的关注。
• 不同用户对平台UI/UX的反馈显示出用户对使用体验的重视，尤其是可读性和视觉层次。

• **平台活跃度质疑**：Sirikon质疑平台活跃度，指出开发者声称"Mastodon is dead"的帖子只有12个回复。
• **个人参与意愿**：gigatexal表示对平台感兴趣，并提到自己很久没登录Mastodon，也不喜欢回声室效应。

data.title: Payment processors' bar on Japanese adult content endangers democracy (2024)
data.author: thisislife2
data.article_summary: Yoko Taro, creator of *Drakengard* and *NieR: Automata*, recently criticized Western credit card companies for pressuring Japanese adult content platforms, highlighting the danger of payment processors censoring legal content and potentially compromising free speech and democracy. This follows the shutdown of Manga Library Z due to pressure from international payment processors, and affects platforms like DLsite, Skeb, and Pixiv. Yoko Taro warns that allowing payment processors to exert such control could enable countries to undermine the democracy of others.
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：支付处理对民主、自由和内容审查的影响，以及支付系统的中立性和去中心化解决方案的潜力。

不同观点：
• [numpad0] 认为Steam遭受的攻击不仅仅是澳大利亚的邪教激进组织所为，而是一个更为系统性的问题。他提出需要像网络中立性一样的"支付中立性"，以确保支付系统的公平性。

• [LorenPechtel] 强调政府的干预通过支付处理机构对民主构成威胁。他认为不同政治派别对政府施压的反应不同，右翼更团结，而左翼则较为松散。

• [tptacek] 认为这个话题已经讨论过，不需要重复讨论2024年的事件，提供了一个相关讨论的链接。

• [o999] 指出所谓的"民主"实际上并不存在，激进活动和罢工在欧美常被定性为非法或恐怖主义行为。他提到美国的铁路罢工、加拿大卡车司机罢工等例子，认为在这些背景下讨论成人内容禁令是天真的。

• [xterminator] 建议每个国家的中央银行应有自己的国家支付处理系统，例如西班牙的Bizum，以减少对少数支付处理公司的依赖。

• [atleastoptimal] 认为支付处理公司的行为不是道德 crusade，而是对各种道德倡导团体的压力做出让步。

• [draxter65] 指出支付公司对成人网站支付持欢迎态度，认为这种人为的愤怒没有道理，小规模的激进团体能造成如此大的影响令人担忧。

• [hsuduebc2] 批评少数美国公司控制全球支付并屈服于社交媒体和清教徒游说团体的压力， censoring全球内容以取悦股东。他提到Visa和Mastercard多年来缺乏创新，依赖于习惯而非实际优势，同时指出像稳定币和欧洲支付系统等替代方案正在崛起。

• [hnpolicestate] 认为让人们采用Monero比通过立法实现支付中立性更为可行，同时指出西方民主趋势是减少自由和增加控制。

• [ur-whale] 认为中心化支付处理本身是威胁自由的问题所在，提出比特币是解决方案。

• [r33b33] 简单建议使用比特币。

• [gjsman-1000] 指出大多数国家对成人内容不宽容，例如日本有审查制度，印度和俄罗斯等国则完全禁止。他认为全球多数国家 censoring或禁止成人内容，西方国家是例外，但这种情况正在改变。

• [kkfx] 认为支付服务提供商（PSPs）威胁民主，因为理论上可以通过P2P交换电子现金，无需依赖银行系统，并提到人们似乎没有意识到这一点。

• 争议焦点在于支付处理公司对内容审查和民主的影响，以及去中心化解决方案如比特币是否能解决这些问题。
• 讨论还涉及到全球各国对成人内容的监管差异，以及这种监管对支付处理公司的影响。
• 不同观点对支付中立性的必要性和实现途径有显著分歧，一些人支持立法改革，另一些人则看好去中心化技术如比特币。

44627828.article_content:
Drakengard and NieR: Automata creator Yoko Taro recently joined in on the discourse surrounding Western credit card payment processors and the pressure they have been exerting on Japanese adult content platforms in the past year.
In a post on his personal X account, Yoko Taro
commented
:
About credit card payment companies refusing to process payments for legal adult content
.
Publishing and similar fields have always faced regulations that go beyond the law, but the fact that a payment processor, which is involved in the entire infrastructure of content distribution, can do such things at its own discretion seems to me to be dangerous on a whole new level.
It implies that by controlling payment processing companies, you can even censor another country’s free speech.
In a
follow-up tweet
, Yoko Taro goes on to say that “I feel like it’s not just a matter of censoring adult content or jeopardizing freedom of expression, but rather a security hole that endangers democracy itself.”
The game director’s statement was most likely triggered by the news that
Manga Library Z is shutting down
. The platform, which has preserved digital editions of out-of-print manga for the past 14 years, was initially pressured by international credit card companies to remove manga that contained certain words, and then abruptly forced to terminate all of its payment contracts, leaving it with no way to secure revenue for its authors. The cause cited for this was transactions involving adult content.
In similar ways, Japanese comic, game, and art platforms like DLsite, Skeb, Fantia, Pixiv and Niconico have been forced to accommodate
censorship requirements
from payment processors and rely on alternative
payment options
that are largely underused by their users (such as crypto and Japan-exclusive e-money and convenience store payments).
Yoko Taro argues that the power payment processors are able to exert on platforms is dangerous not only in terms of legal erotic media being censored, but also because it can potentially allow countries to compromise the democracy of others.

data.title: FFmpeg devs boast of another 100x leap thanks to handwritten assembly code
data.author: harambae
data.article_summary: FFmpeg项目开发者通过手写汇编代码实现了显著的性能提升，最新补丁使某一函数的性能提升了100倍，但仅适用于特定功能“rangedetect8_avx512”，而非整个软件。该函数使用SIMD并行处理技术，针对现代处理器进行了优化。尽管编译器能将高级语言转换为机器代码，但在性能优化上手写汇编仍具优势。FFmpeg团队以手写汇编著称，并积极推广相关技术。VLC等流行软件也依赖FFmpeg的库进行媒体处理。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：FFmpeg中手写汇编代码带来的性能提升及其相关争议

不同观点：
• AaronAPU：基于他在SIMD优化方面的经验，认为100倍的性能提升具有误导性。他指出，这种对比往往是在极端简化的微基准测试中进行的，而在实际应用中，性能提升可能不那么显著。缓存效应在实际使用中会减弱这种提升。
• Aardwolf：对文章中100倍和100%的性能提升描述混淆不清提出质疑，指出这两者有本质区别，要求澄清。
• blueflow：批评文章标题具有误导性，实际性能提升仅在某个 obscure filter 中可见，整体性能改进并不显著。
• ivanjermakov：提供了一个相关链接，关于如何为FFmpeg编写汇编代码的指南。
• cpncrunch：对文章中提到的“rangedetect8_avx512”函数具体使用场景和整体转换过程中的实际性能改进表示困惑，要求更明确的说明。
• jabjoe：分享了自己通过调整编译器选项而非手写汇编代码来实现性能优化的经验，强调了编译器优化的重要性。
• pavlov：指出这些优化仅适用于x86/x86-64架构，并感慨尽管SIMD优化曾经有广泛应用前景，但现在x86架构的普遍性下降，使得这些优化不再如以前有用。
• tombert：对汇编代码比优化过的C代码更快表示惊讶，原以为现代编译器已经足够智能以缩小这种性能差距。
• Ygg2：认为虽然单个函数的性能提升了100倍，但不代表整个程序的性能有显著提升，甚至可能因为资源争用而导致整体性能下降。
• bravesoul2：简单纠正100倍的描述，暗示对原文描述的不满。
• shmerl：表达了对FFmpeg CLI中某些功能支持迟迟未实现的不满，与主要讨论点略有偏离。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于文章中提到的100倍性能提升是否真实且具有实际意义。
• 对性能提升的描述存在混淆，读者对100倍和100%的区别感到困惑。
• 讨论中涉及手写汇编代码与编译器优化的对比，以及现代编译器在优化方面的进展。
• 实际应用场景中的性能提升可能不如微基准测试中显著，缓存效应和资源争用是重要因素。

44629206.article_content:
(Image credit: FFmpeg)
The developers behind the FFmpeg project are again claiming major performance uplifts delivered by wielding the art of handwritten assembly code. With the
latest patch
applied, users should see a “100x speedup” in the cross-platform open-source media transcoding application. However, the developers were soon to clarify that the 100x claim applies to just a single function, “not the whole of FFmpeg.”
BREAKING: FFmpeg 100x speedup from handwritten assembly13:55:30 <•haasn> rangedetect8_avx512: 121.2 (100.18x) that may be the biggest speedup I've seen so far
July 16, 2025
“The biggest speedup I've seen so far”
Last November, we reported on an FFmpeg performance boost that could speed certain operations
by up to 94x
. The latest handwritten assembly patch boosts the app’s ‘rangedetect8_avx512’ performance by 100.73%. If your modern processor doesn’t support AVX512, you should still see a 65.63% uplift with the rangedetect8_avx2 code path.
Where will you feel these speed increases? In some follow-up tweets, the FFmpeg developers admit that “It's a single function that's now 100x faster, not the whole of FFmpeg.” They would later go on to elaborate that the functionality, which might enjoy a 100% speed boost, depending upon your system, was “an obscure filter.”
You may like
7-Zip for Windows goes massively parallel with first ‘Threadripper Edition’ — five years after Threadripper debut, Version 25.00 the first to support more than 64 threads
New display hits 1 million FPS — display and high-speed camera could enable 1 Tbps speeds
AMD's Threadripper 9995WX stuns in Cinebench R23 — new Ryzen flagship reportedly 73% faster than its predecessor
The obscurity of the function means it hadn’t been prioritized by the devs until now. But we also gather that the filter code was recoded using the SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) processing concept for vastly improved parallel processing on today’s powerful chips.
Evidently, compilers – programs that take higher-level language code and spit out assembly (machine) code – are still not competitive with handwritten assembly. Or you could say, “register allocator sucks on compilers,” as FFmpeg tweeted today.
(Image credit: FFmpeg)
Assembly language evangelicals
Harking back to the golden age of home computing in the 1980s and 1990s, where fixed-spec systems had lifecycles measured in half-decades - and strictly limited processing resources - handwritten assembly code optimizations played a larger part in the business of speeding up computers, games, and other software.
FFmpeg is perhaps one of the few ‘assembly evangelists’ remaining. The dev team even
runs a ‘school.’

• bravesoul2：简单纠正100倍的描述，暗示对原文描述的不满。
• shmerl：表达了对FFmpeg CLI中某些功能支持迟迟未实现的不满，与主要讨论点略有偏离。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于文章中提到的100倍性能提升是否真实且具有实际意义。
• 对性能提升的描述存在混淆，读者对100倍和100%的区别感到困惑。
• 讨论中涉及手写汇编代码与编译器优化的对比，以及现代编译器在优化方面的进展。
• 实际应用场景中的性能提升可能不如微基准测试中显著，缓存效应和资源争用是重要因素。

data.title: Show HN: X11 desktop widget that shows location of your network peers on a map
data.author: h2337
data.article_summary: **connmap** 是一个开源的 X11 桌面小部件，能够在世界地图上实时显示当前网络 peers 的地理位置，支持 Wayland。主要功能包括通过 geo-ip 定位网络连接，并提供可配置的界面选项。安装需通过 Git 克隆仓库并使用 Makefile 编译，依赖于 xlib、cairo 等库。用户可自定义小部件位置、地图宽度及更新间隔等。目前仅支持 i3 窗口管理器，且只支持 IPv4 网络。项目采用 MIT 许可证。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对一个网络连接可视化工具的评价和建议

不同观点：
• [lloeki] 提到 LittleSnitch 也有类似的地图功能，但指出 LittleSnitch 是主动处理连接，因此列表更准确，而该工具使用 `ss` 命令获取连接信息，可能在刷新间隔期间遗漏部分连接。
• [itomato] 认为该工具给人一种过时的感觉，类似于Y2K时代（2000年左右）的风格。
• [hamburglar] 认为该工具使用了简单的C语言和`popen`函数，虽然直接但有效，同时建议从`/proc`目录获取连接信息。他还提到地图不易读，尤其是小尺寸时，建议用实心颜色填充陆地以提高可读性，并提出让点逐渐淡出的视觉效果建议。
• [heikkilevanto] 对地图的可读性提出批评，指出海岸线和边界过多，难以定位国家，尤其是地中海地区，并建议用实心颜色填充陆地和淡出点的视觉效果。
• [kleiba] 认为该工具给人一种未来科幻电影界面的感觉。
• [rootbear] 表示不理解工具展示的内容，提到自己运行工具时看到的红点位置与实际地理位置不符。
• [globalnode] 质疑该工具是否能捕捉短命的连接或隐藏的UDP连接。
• [raldi] 询问“网络 peer”的定义。
• [Aldipower] 提到该工具在WindowMaker中运行良好，并已添加到自动启动中。
• [GranPC] 觉得该工具酷似游戏《Uplink》。
• [freeone3000] 开玩笑地提到要确保 interNIC 是第一跳，并提到 LogDeleter 的重要性。

• [generalizations] 推测该工具是由i3wm用户开发的，并称赞其做得好。
• [ben0x539] 认为这是一个很酷的想法。
• [Tom1380] 建议在工具中添加类似traceroute的跳点线路展示，以增强视觉效果。

补充讨论：
• 地图可读性和视觉效果是用户讨论的重点，尤其是对小尺寸地图的改进建议。
• 部分用户对工具捕捉连接的准确性提出质疑，尤其是短命和UDP连接。
• 用户对工具的未来科幻风格表示赞赏，并提出与其他界面和游戏的相似性。
• 一些用户提供了技术建议和功能扩展想法，如从`/proc`获取连接信息和traceroute跳点展示。

connmap
connmap is an X11 desktop widget that shows location of your current network peers on a world map.
(Works on Wayland as well!)
Installation
Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/h2337/connmap --depth 1
, install the dependencies (see below), run
make install
, then run the resulting executable
./connmap.elf
.
If you want to run it without attaching it to the terminal then add ampersand at the end of the command:
./connmal.elf &
.
You can also add it to your i3wm config to run at startup (make sure it is in the PATH):
exec --no-startup-id connmap.elf
Dependencies
Build dependencies:
xlib
,
libxext
,
libxfixes
,
libcairo2
Installation dependencies:
unzip
Runtime dependencies:
iproute2
Installation for Arch Linux:
sudo pacman -S --needed iproute2 libx11 libxext libxfixes cairo unzip
Installation for Ubuntu:
sudo apt install iproute2 libx11-dev libxext-dev libxfixes-dev libcairo2-dev unzip
Config
Installation will create
~/.config/connmap/connmaprc
. Default
connmaprc
looks like this:
location_x 20
location_y 500
map_width 1000
black false
update_interval 1
location_x
/
location_y
specifies the initial widget location in your desktop (you can later drag/drop the widget with mouse if you are not using a desktop environment that treats mouse drag as multi-select).
map_width
specifies the custom pixel width of the map. Height is automatically calculated as width/2. Examples:
map_width 500
creates a 500×250px map
map_width 1000
creates a 1000×500px map
map_width 1500
creates a 1500×750px map
map_width 2000
creates a 2000×1000px map
Setting
black
to true will draw map outline in black instead of white.
update_interval
is seconds the application will sleep for before fetching the updated list of network connections.
Limitations
Tested only with i3wm, might not work as expected in other DE/WM.
Only IPv4 is supported.

data.title: Man wearing metallic necklace dies after being sucked into MRI machine
data.author: brudgers
data.article_summary: 一名61岁男子在美国纽约长岛的一家医疗中心未经允许进入正在运行的磁共振成像（MRI）机房，因佩戴沉重金属项链被吸向机器，导致死亡。该男子是应妻子请求入内帮忙，其项链重约9公斤，用于健身。事故发生时，技术员试图将他拉离机器，但未能成功。男子随后被送医，翌日不治身亡。MRI机器使用强大磁场生成影像，通常要求患者去除金属物品。此前，2001年纽约市也曾发生类似事故，一名六岁男孩因氧气罐被吸入而死亡。警方正在调查此事件。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：MRI扫描过程中发生的事故及其相关的安全问题

不同观点：
• **bookofjoe**（麻醉医师）指出，在MRI室进行麻醉会引发焦虑，因为该环境缺乏紧急情况下的支援。MRI室与手术室不同，通常孤立无援，且监控条件有限。他提到，这类事故虽然少见但确实会发生，并曾在麻醉文献中被讨论过。

• **unsupp0rted** 从进化心理学的角度解释，人们对现代科技的危险缺乏直觉的感知。比如，人们对蜘蛛或毒蛇会有天然的警觉，但对强磁场却没有相应的警觉机制。

• **OisinMoran** 对事件描述中使用模糊术语如“项链”和“医疗事件”表示质疑，认为这些词汇掩盖了事故的真实原因，并要求明确死亡的具体原因。

• **tsoukase** 认为MRI事故极为罕见，相较于成功案例来说几乎可以忽略不计。他还指出，CT/MRI中心的更大风险来自于患者对造影剂的过敏反应，而非设备本身。

• **avalys** 强调事故的核心问题是MRI操作人员的基本安全措施失效，特别是对房间的准入控制不当。即使该男子未佩戴金属链，他也不应被允许进入MRI室。

• **potato3732842** 反驳了有些人对事故的轻描淡写，指出涉事链条为健身用的重物，受害者因被压住而窒息死亡，而非简单被物体击中。

• **lordnacho** 提出一个技术性问题，即为什么磁铁总是“吸引”而不是“排斥”物体。

• **poulpy123** 表示大多数人对MRI的危险缺乏理解，并引用FDA的警告，指出即使是小金属物品在MRI磁场中也可能成为危险投射物。他质疑事件中的多处细节，如为什么患者妻子要找丈夫帮忙而不是技术人员。

• **russfink** 分享了个人经历，讲述自己曾在MRI室外因金属笔被磁力吸引而感到惊恐，强调了MRI磁力的强大。

• **seydor** 认为普通项链不会导致如此严重的事故，涉事的链条是用于健身的重物，暗示这种物品本不该在医院佩戴。

• **JdeBP** 批评BBC新闻在报道中不如Fox News详细，特别是在安全标志和警示细节方面，认为BBC在报道美国新闻时表现不如美国本土媒体。

• **htk** 认为事故反映了现代人缺乏对规则的尊重，指出涉事男子未经许可进入MRI室是明显违反安全规定的行为。

• **jleyank** 强调有些规则是基于物理和生物学原理，而不是人为的限制。人们需要尊重这些规则，因为违反它们可能导致严重后果。

• **kylecazar** 指出任何不该进入MRI室的人都不应被允许进入，并质疑涉事男子为何佩戴重达20磅的链条出现在医院。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于MRI操作人员是否尽责确保安全措施，特别是在准入控制方面。
• 有人质疑媒体在描述事件时用词模糊，未清楚传达事故的真实原因和风险。
• 个人经历和观察提供了对MRI磁力强大和潜在危险的直观理解。

44630760.article_content:
Man wearing heavy metallic necklace dies after being sucked into MRI machine
3 hours ago
Share
Save
Madeline Halpert
BBC News, New York
Share
Save
Getty Images
Patients are advised to remove metal items before going near an MRI machine
A 61-year-old man has died after he was sucked into a Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) machine at a medical centre while he was wearing a heavy metal necklace.
The man, who has not been identified, entered a room at Nassau Open MRI in Westbury, on New York's Long Island, without permission as the MRI machine was running, Nassau County Police Department said.
A patient at the facility told local media her husband was the one who died. She said she had called him into the room after she had a scan on Wednesday.
Officials say the incident "resulted in a medical episode" and the man was taken to the hospital, where he died on Thursday. MRI machines use a strong magnetic field to produce detailed images.
Patients are typically asked to remove metal items and change out of their clothes before undergoing MRI scans or going near the machine.
"The male victim was wearing a large metallic chain around his neck causing him to be drawn into the machine, which resulted in a medical episode," said Nassau County Police Department, which is investigating the incident.
Though police have not named the victim, Adrienne Jones-McAllister told local television station
News 12 Long Island
that it was her husband, Keith, who died.
"He waved goodbye to me and then his whole body went limp," she said tearfully.
Ms Jones-McAllister told the outlet she was getting an MRI on her knee and asked her husband to come in to help her get up afterwards. She said he was wearing a 20lb (9kg) chain with a lock that he used for weight training.
"At that instant, the machine switched him around, pulled him in, and he hit the MRI," she said.
Ms Jones-McAllister said the technician had tried to pull her husband away from the machine.
"I'm saying, 'Could you turn off the machine?" she told the outlet. "Call 911. Do something. Turn this damn thing off!'"
The BBC has contacted Nassau Open MRI for comment.
According to the US Food and Drug Administration, MRI machines have magnetic fields that will attract magnetic objects of all sizes - keys, mobile phones and even oxygen tanks - which "may cause damage to the scanner or injury to the patient or medical professionals if those objects become projectiles".
In 2001, a six-year-old boy died of a fractured skull at a New York City medical centre while undergoing an MRI exam after its powerful magnetic force propelled an oxygen tank across the room.

• **seydor** 认为普通项链不会导致如此严重的事故，涉事的链条是用于健身的重物，暗示这种物品本不该在医院佩戴。

data.article_summary: 这篇文章分析了神经网络前向传播和反向传播的计算复杂性，重点讨论了时间复杂度的局限性，尤其是在深度学习中使用GPU时应考虑并行计算的效率。文章指出，前向传播涉及矩阵乘法和激活函数的计算，其时间复杂度主要由矩阵乘法的O(n^3)和激活函数的O(n)组成。综合考虑各层神经元的计算量，前向传播的总时间复杂度为O(n^4)。类似地，反向传播的复杂度分析也得出相似的结论。文章建议使用如工作深度（work depth）和跨度（span）等更适合并行算法的指标来补充传统的时间复杂度分析。

44630676.article_content:
Computational Complexity Of Neural Networks
Sept. 2022
March 2025
In order to motivate why we separate the training and inference phases of neural networks, it can be useful to analyse the computational complexity.
This essay assumes familiarity with analytical complexity analysis of algorithms, and hereunder big-O notation. If you need a recap, you should read the essay on
computational complexity
before continuing.
⭐
Time complexity might not be the best metric to reason about algorithms which are highly parallel which most linear algebra operations are.
The time complexity does not capture the parallelism, and reports the same complexity for a fully parallel algorithm as a sequential one if they have the same number of total steps.
But with GPUs being ubiquitous in deep learning algorithms, we should really look for better metrics such as
work depth
, and
span
. This article still has merits on its own, but the time complexity results should be understood with proper context.
Forward propagation
Looking at inference part of a feed forward neural network, we have forward propagation.
Finding the asymptotic complexity of the forward propagation procedure can be done much like we how we found the run-time complexity of matrix multiplication.
Before beginning, you should be familiar with the
forward propagation procedure
.
We assume the input-vector can be described as:
$$x \in \mathbb{R}^{n}$$
Where the first element is the bias unit: $x_0 = 1$.
When implementing neural networks, it's often the case that all the samples are collected into a matrix with the dimensions $x \in \mathbb{R}^{\eta \times n}$ where $\eta$ is the total number of samples in the trainingset. This is done to save time on allocating memory, and is primarily a practical problem which is why we won't consider it further in the theory.
The input is treated in the same as any other activation matrix, and has the index: $x=a^{(0)}$. The zeroth element, $a_0^{(0)}$ is as usual the bias unit with a value of 1.
About forward propagation, we can write:
$$z^{(k)} = \theta^{(k)} a^{(k-1)}$$
$$z^{(k)} \in \mathbb{R}^{1 \times (m | \theta^{(k)}\in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n})}$$
$$a^{(k)} = g\big( z^{(k)} \big)$$
Where $g(x)$ is the activation function which is evaluated elementwise. We therefore know that $a^{(k)}$ has the same dimensions as $z^{(k)}$.
We see that for each layer a matrix multiplication, and an activation function is computed. We know from the the previous essay that naive matrix multiplication has a asymptotic run-time of $O(n^3)$, and since $g(x)$ is an elementwise function, we know that it has a run-time of $O(n)$.
By analysing the dimensions of a feed forward neural network, we find:
$$\theta^{(0)} \in \mathbb{R}^{n^{(0)} \times 1}$$
$$\theta^{(1)} \in \mathbb{R}^{n^{(1)} \times n^{(0)}} $$
$$\theta^{(2)} \in \mathbb{R}^{n^{(2)} \times n^{(1)}}$$
More generally, we can write:
$$\theta^{(k)}= \begin{cases} \mathbb{R}^{n^{(k)}\times 1} \quad &\text{if} \space k=0\\ \mathbb{R}^{n^{(k)}\times n^{(k-1)}} \quad &\text{if} \space k>0 \end{cases}$$
Where $n^{(k)}$ is the number of neurons including the bias unit in layer $k$.
Recalling $zad$ from the previous post, we see that:
$$ \begin{aligned} a &= n^{(k)} \\ z &= n^{(k-1)} \\ d &= n^{(k-2)} \end{aligned} $$
From this we find that:
$$\begin{aligned} n_{mul} &= \sum_{k=2}^{n_{layers}} \big( n^{(k)}n^{(k-1)}n^{(k-2)} \big) + \big( n^{(1)}n^{(0)}1 \big) \\ n_{g} &= \sum_{k=1}^{n_{layers}} \big( n^{(k)} \big) \\ \end{aligned} $$
Where $n_{mul}$ is the number of multiplications performed, and $n_g$ is how many times we apply the activation function, $g$.
It should be noted, however, that we have rather naively assumed that $a^{(k)}$ has the same dimension as $\theta^{(k)}$ which is obviously not the case as $a^{(k)}\in \mathbb{R}^{n^{(k)}}$. (Thanks Chuanting Zhang for suggesting making this assumption more clear.)
This gives us:
$$ \begin{aligned} \text{time} &= n_{mul} + n_{g} \Leftrightarrow \\ \text{time} &= \sum_{k=2}^{n_{layers}} \big( n^{(k)}n^{(k-1)}n^{(k-2)} \big) + \big( n^{(1)}n^{(0)}1 \big) + \sum_{k=1}^{n_{layers}} \big( n^{(k)} \big) \end{aligned} $$
When analysing matrix algorithms, it's common to assume that the matrices are quadratic; that is they have the same number of rows, as columns. By doing this, we find that:
$$n_{mul} = n_{layers} \cdot n^{3}$$
If we once again assume that there are the same number of neurons in each layer, and that the number of layers equal the number of neurons in each layer we find:
$$n_{mul} = O(n\cdot n^3) = O(n^4)$$
The same can be done for the activations:
$$n_g = n_{layers} \cdot n = O(n^2)$$
The total run-time therefore becomes:
$$O(n^4+n^2) \Leftrightarrow$$
$$O(n^4) \because \forall n \geq 1 \space |\space n^4+n^2 \leq 2n^4$$
Backpropagation
We can find the run-time complexity of backpropagation in a similar manner.
Before beginning, you should be familiar with the
backpropagation procedure
.
We can safely ignore $\text{time}_{\nabla_a}$

data.title: Peep Show is the most realistic portrayal of evil I have seen (2020)
data.author: Michelangelo11
data.article_summary:
《Peep Show》是一部2003年至2015年播出的英国电视剧，由大卫·米切尔和罗伯特·韦伯饰演两位生活在伦敦克罗伊登的悲惨且相互依赖的室友。本文认为该剧呈现了一种“现实的邪恶”，这种邪恶并非传统意义上的恶意或极端恶行，而是一种源于本能或粗心大意导致不良后果的行为。主角马克和杰瑞米并非像连环杀手或独裁者那样邪恶，但他们体现了每个人都可能拥有的最糟糕、最具破坏性的特质：懦弱、逃避、虚伪和冷漠，这些特质源于未被正视的自我厌恶。

该剧通过九季内容挖掘了我们最深的恐惧和失败以制造笑料，展示了现代三十多岁人群在爱情、工作、友情等方面的困境。剧中的角色不仅通过日常行为展示这些特质，还通过内心独白揭示其 cynical（愤世嫉俗）的动机和谎言。

本文指出，《Peep Show》以一种“平庸的邪恶”方式呈现邪恶，类似于汉娜·阿伦特对阿道夫·艾希曼的分析。马克和杰瑞米的行为虽不及艾希曼的罪行，但他们平凡的外表和行为之间的对比令人震惊。该剧让观众对坏角色产生共鸣，尽管他们从未真正吸取教训，使之成为一种反面榜样。
data.comments_summary:

不同观点：
• [annie_muss] 认为低自尊和不安全感是导致邪恶行为的原因。她以自身经历为例，指出当人觉得自己不如别人时，可能会通过恶意行为试图拉低他人以获得某种正义感。
• [jl6] 支持低自尊是邪恶根源的观点，并引用Unabomber的案例以及对incel文化的现代分析作为论据，进一步说明低自尊在心理学中的影响。
• [jakebennet89] 称赞文章对《Peep Show》的深刻分析，认为Mark和Jez的角色揭示了“现实的邪恶”，并通过与Arendt的比较增加了分析的深度。
• [aosaigh] 部分同意文章的观点，但对“重新定义邪恶”的核心前提持保留态度，认为尽管分析有趣且准确，但主要前提不成立。
• [Duanemclemore] 简要总结《Peep Show》为Mark没有尊严、Jez没有羞耻感的展现，并认为文章是对这一观点的详细扩展。

• [mlsu] 引用Arendt对Eichmann的分析，认为邪恶的根源在于人们在日常生活中的“默认”或“被动”立场，并指出拒绝这种立场是道德责任。对文章中将低自尊视为邪恶根源的观点提出异议，认为懦弱才是邪恶的根源。
• [thom] 对讨论邪恶的必要性提出质疑，认为《Peep Show》更像是一个关于傲慢和人类脆弱的悲喜剧故事，类似于莎士比亚和古希腊的经典作品。
• [mgoetzke] 表达了对无法通过流媒体服务观看《Peep Show》的失望，反映了2025年内容获取的现实问题。
• [tab_jockey] 具体引用剧中角色行为（如对狗的处理）来展示角色的不道德行为。
• [reagle] 以讽刺口吻质疑剧中角色是否是“坏人”。
• [hallero] 将《Peep Show》归类为“社会恐怖”，认为文章进一步强化了这一观点。
• [jancsika] 对文章中对现实主义的关注表示不解，认为像《The Thick of It》这样的作品尽管不现实，但能很好地捕捉政治 incompetence和腐败的本质。
• [yakshaving_jgt] 强烈推荐观看《Peep Show》，没有详细分析，但表达了对作品的肯定。

补充讨论：
- 评论中多次提到低自尊作为邪恶行为的根源，这一观点得到一些评论者的支持，但也有人（如mlsu）提出异议，认为懦弱才是根本原因。
- 对《Peep Show》的幽默风格和角色缺陷的讨论是另一个焦点，部分评论者将其与《Succession》和《Seinfeld》等作品进行比较。
- 对文章中“重新定义邪恶”的核心观点存在争议，部分评论者认同，部分则持保留或反对态度。
- 内容获取问题（如无法通过流媒体观看《Peep Show》）也被提及，反映了现代观众在获取经典内容时面临的实际困难。

Peep Show
, a British tv series running from 2003 to 2015, starring David Mitchell and Robert Webb as a pair of miserable, co-dependent roommates living in Croydon, London,
is the most realistic portrayal of evil
I have ever seen.
Admittedly, I’m using “evil” in an unorthodox way. Most people think of “evil” as being synonymous with “malicious” and “doing really, really bad things.” But I have a broader view of “evil.” I consider a thing to be evil if it creates bad outcomes not just out of malice, but instinct or carelessness.
By that standard,
Peep Shows’s
protagonists, Mark Corrigan and Jeremy “Jez” Usborne, are evil. They’re not evil in quite the way serial killers and murderous dictators are, nor in the exaggerated cartoony manner of other comedic anti-heroes like the characters on
It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia, Arrested Development,
or
Archer.
Rather,
Peep Show’s
characters are evil in the scariest way possible – they’re
realistically evil
. They embody the worst, weakest, most destructive traits that every single individual knows exists inside of them to one degree or another. They are evil incarnate.
Through nine seasons (each only six episodes)
Peep Show
mines our worst fears and failures for comedy. We see modern 30-somethings get rejected by women, get trapped in soul-crushing relationships, get one-upped by social rivals, get caught in countless awkward conversations, get screwed by ruthless corporate bullshit, get betrayed by unreliable friends, get betrayed by reliable friends who had already been betrayed, and so much more. We see this all not just by watching Mark and Jez go about their day-to-day lives, but by hearing their inner thoughts through voice-over monologues, which more often than not, reveal their actions and words as either cynical attempts to avoid facing their own failings, or desperate lies to obscure their true intentions, goals, and personalities.
This is what makes
Peep Show
so brilliant. It doesn’t just portray evil realistically, it portrays the
root
of evil realistically. Mark and Jeremy cause bad things to happen to their acquaintances, co-workers, friends, loved ones, family members, and most of all,
themselves
, because they are consumed by their vices. Not just the classic vices like gluttony and lust, but
cowardice, evasion, hypocrisy,
and
apathy
, all born from a rarely acknowledged, yet omnipresent
self-loathing
. These are vices that aren’t loudly announced by violent psychopaths or easily identified in scary individuals, but vices that sneak up on ordinary people, latch on to their psyches, and take over their lives.
Also, it’s one of the funniest tv shows I’ve ever seen.
With this essay, I’ll lay out how
Peep Show
portrays evil, what exactly makes Mark and Jeremy so evil, and how the two protagonists are essentially anti-role models from which we can all take lessons.
The Banality of Evil
Mark:
No, Jez, the absolute worst thing that anyone could say about you is that you are a selfish moral blank whose lazy cynicism and sneering ironic take on the world encapsulates everything wrong with a generation. But you, my friend, are not evil.
Hannah Arendt’s
Eichmann in Jerusalem
first showcased the concept of “banality of evil.” Arendt analyzed Adolph Eichmann, one of the chief bureaucrats behind the Holocaust, expecting to find a mustache-twirling villain who gleefully organized the murder of millions of Jews and other undesirables with gusto. Instead she found an ordinary, boring, middle-manager paper-pusher type who seemed more concerned with getting a spot at the local country club and buying his wife nice outfits than how many gas chambers he filled at work. Eichmann did unimaginably horrible things, but he didn’t
seem
like a horrible person. The way he looked, spoke, and acted made him appear to be a normal dude. To Arendt, that was the scariest thing of all – that such evil could be perpetrated by so banal an individual.
That’s basically how I see Mark and Jeremy on
Peep Show.
Their evil is not on the level of Eichmann, but their personas are so grounded that the contrast between how they appear and what they do is all the more striking.
Peep Show
is a demented sitcom. Like any other sitcom, it’s based on “situational comedy” where the characters find themselves in uncomfortable situations that we laugh at. Like some sitcoms,
Peep Show’s
uncomfortable situations are of the character’s own makings, particularly their bad judgement and moral failings. But unlike any other sitcoms I can think of,
Peep Show
is designed to make you completely
empathize
with the bad characters doing bad things, even though they don’t learn their lessons.
It’s natural when experiencing any story to identify and sympathize with the protagonist. Whether its Tony Soprano or Walter White, we are drawn to root for the primary subject of the story because we understand their motives, perspective, and values more than any other characters. and get to li

What My Mother Didn't Talk About
My mother and I were very close, but when she died last year there was still so much I didn’t know about her.
By
