Description
I'm frequently passed long shell one-liners that require some visual inspection before running. These days, there's about as much jq in that one-liner as there is bash. I wrote jqfmt to help add line breaks in sensible locations while reading (or writing!) jq.
At time of initial development, I naturally turned to
https://github.com/itchyny/gojq
expecting to be able to generate and walk a syntax tree—but gojq didn't seem to provide an AST that could be "walked," and it doesn't export its parsing logic to be used in library form. So, I yanked the relevant code out of
https://github.com/itchyny/gojq/blob/main/query.go
and started from there.
Side note: Ever tried Googling for "jq formatter"? Reading search results is a nightmare since jq itself
is
, among other things, a formatter.
Getting started
Install
go install -v github.com/noperator/jqfmt/cmd/jqfmt@latest
Usage
𝄢 jqfmt -h
Usage of jqfmt:
-ar
arrays
-f string
file
-o	one line
-ob
objects
-op string
operators
-v	verbose
Let's take this line of jq…
𝄢 echo '{one: .two, three: [.four, .five, [.fivetwo, .fivethree]], six: map(select((.seven | .eight | .nine)))}' |
jqfmt
{ one: .two, three: [.four, .five, [.fivetwo, .fivethree]], six: map(select((.seven | .eight | .nine))) }
…and format objects.
𝄢 echo '{one: .two, three: [.four, .five, [.fivetwo, .fivethree]], six: map(select((.seven | .eight | .nine)))}' |
jqfmt -ob
{
one: .two,
three: [.four, .five, [.fivetwo, .fivethree]],
six: map(select((.seven | .eight | .nine)))
}
Nice! Let's also do arrays.
𝄢 echo '{one: .two, three: [.four, .five, [.fivetwo, .fivethree]], six: map(select((.seven | .eight | .nine)))}' |
jqfmt -ob -ar
{
one: .two,
three: [
.four,
.five,
[
.fivetwo,
.fivethree
]
],
six: map(select((.seven | .eight | .nine)))
}
It'll read easier if we also break on pipes.
𝄢 echo '{one: .two, three: [.four, .five, [.fivetwo, .fivethree]], six: map(select((.seven | .eight | .nine)))}' |
jqfmt -ob -ar -op pipe
{
one: .two,
three: [
.four,
.five,
[
.fivetwo,
.fivethree
]
],
six: map(select((.seven |
.eight |
.nine)))
}

@colindean for helping me believe that jqfmt was a reasonable thing to build.
@tracertea for writing jq lines long enough to warrant a formatter.
@addyosmani for "First do it, then do it right, then do it better." I wrote this on a plane (as the
best
tools
are) over a year ago, but always had more features I wanted to add before releasing it. Doing it "right" might mean a refactor or clean-up; "better" would probably mean incorporating an AST.

44637716.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕工具 **jq** 及其相关工具（如 **jqfmt**）的讨论，包括使用体验、优缺点以及替代方案。

不同观点：
• **支持并分享使用经验**：[rwiggins] 对 jq 有很高的评价，并分享了自己常用的一个 jq 单行命令来分析文档结构，同时对 jqfmt 工具进行了测试和反馈，认为其格式化功能不错，但希望有些默认行为可以改进。

• **澄清误解**：[Hendrikto] 指出 "jq formatter" 在搜索时容易引起误解，因为 jq 本身可以格式化命令，而不是直接格式化 JSON 数据，帮助读者更好理解讨论背景。

• **质疑单行命令的复杂性**：[s17n] 认为如果需要格式化单行命令，可能它就不应该被写成单行，暗示 jq 命令有时过于复杂，对工具的存在表示一定质疑，但仍认可工具的创新性。

• **对工具默认设置的建议**：[kiitos] 建议 jqfmt 工具应该默认启用一些常用格式化规则，而不是让用户手动启用每一个规则，从而提升用户体验。

• **对 jq 的批评和使用困难**：[xmonkee] 表示不喜欢 jq，认为其命令难以记忆和使用，且文档难以理解。每年仅使用一次，但每次都需要重新学习，暗示工具的学习曲线陡峭。

• **替代工具推荐**：[mikeocool] 提到最近使用 fx (fx.wtf) 作为 jq 的替代工具，提供类似 JavaScript 的接口，可以完成类似 jq 的处理任务。

• **幽默评论**：[guerrilla] 以幽默方式表示对标题的误解，增加了一些轻松的讨论氛围。

• **工具作者回应及推广**：[noperator] 作为 jqfmt 工具的作者，回应了讨论，并推广了自己开发的另一个工具 sol，用于 shell 单行命令的美化。

data.title: AccountingBench: Evaluating LLMs on real long-horizon business tasks
data.author: rickcarlino
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLMs在会计任务中的表现及其局限性

不同观点：
• yunyu（项目成员）认为，LLMs（如Claude和Grok 4）在初期表现良好，但随着数据增多表现下降。错误主要源于奖励机制的漏洞利用而非纯粹的幻觉问题。项目团队认为通过更严格的框架可以提升表现，但目前更关注能力研究。
• vlade11115担心LLMs可能导致无意中的欺诈行为，尤其是在政府尝试使用LLMs进行会计验证时。对盲目信任LLMs持怀疑态度。
• pton_xd对LLMs的深度能力感到惊叹，认为尽管目前存在问题，但未来很有前景。
• lufenialif2基于自身经验认为，LLMs目前最好的用途是作为高级自动补全工具，而非万能解决方案。
• Havoc认为LLMs在基础会计工作（如费用分类）上即将取代人工，但对精确度要求高的工作（如税务申报）仍不适合。
• tantalor指出会计中待处理交易应纳入余额计算，而非简单地允许差异存在，认为这种做法不专业。
• lucianbr和mixdup都提到LLMs缺乏对任务目标的真正理解，长期实验结果多为失败。非确定性软件在高度精确的领域中应用可能导致不良后果。
• vachina将LLMs比喻为 jackhammer，认为只有在严格控制下才能有效工作，否则可能破坏任务。
• abc03指出许多会计初创公司仍需大量人工劳动，AI替代本地会计师尚需时日。
• magicmicah85希望LLMs在不确定时能够放弃任务并交回人类处理，而非忽视指令继续前进。
• axus和rapind以幽默和类比方式讨论LLMs在会计领域的适用性。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及LLMs在会计任务中可能导致的欺诈问题，以及在高度监管环境下的适用性。
• 多个评论提到LLMs在精确度要求高的工作中表现不足，强调人类监督的重要性。
• 部分评论对LLMs的未来发展持积极态度，认为尽管目前存在局限，但未来有很大潜力。
• 对LLMs错误类型（如奖励机制漏洞利用和幻觉问题）的分析也是讨论的重点。

data.title: New records on Wendelstein 7-X
data.author: greesil
data.article_summary: Wendelstein 7-X，世界上最大的仿星器类型核聚变设备，在最新的实验中取得了多项新里程碑。最显著的是，它创造了三重积（衡量核聚变设备接近净能量输出能力的指标）的世界纪录，实现了在43秒内维持高三重积值。三重积由离子温度、密度和能量 confinement 时间三个因素决定，是实现自持核聚变反应的关键。此次突破得益于国际合作，尤其是与欧洲聚变联盟EUROfusion及美国伙伴的合作，使用氢颗粒注入器实现了长时间的等离子体放电。此次实验还达到了能量转换和等离子体压力等方面的里程碑，标志着仿星器概念迈向实用化的重要一步。

不同观点：

• saddat 提供了一个视频链接，可能包含有关实验结果的图表，但未对具体数据进行详细讨论。
• bradleyy 对“长时间维持高三重积的等离子体”这种模糊描述提出质疑，认为需要更明确的比较基准来评价实验进展。
• apples_oranges 认为一旦核聚变技术成熟，设备的复杂性可能会显著降低，暗示当前设计可能只是探索阶段的必要复杂性。

• cubefox 提供了文章原始来源的链接，供读者查阅更多详细信息。

44636204.article_content:
Fusion world
New records on Wendelstein 7-X
10 Jun 2025
Print
Read the latest published articles
Wendelstein 7-X—the leading fusion device of the stellarator type—achieved several new performance milestones during its latest run of experiments. Among them is a world record for triple product, the value that measures how close a fusion device is to generating net energy across the plasma.
Wendelstein 7-X is the world’s largest fusion device of the stellarator type. Photo: MPI for Plasma Physics, Jan Hosan
Also called the Lawson Criteria,
fusion triple product
defines the threshold that must be exceeded for a plasma to produce more fusion power than the heating power injected. It marks the point where the energy balance across the plasma becomes positive, and the fusion reaction can sustain itself without (or with greatly reduced) external heating. The triple product is derived from three factors—ion temperature (T), density (n) and energy confinement time (τ). In any future fusion power plant, a plasma with a high triple product must be maintained for long periods.
On the last day of its OP 2.3 campaign, which ended on May 22, the Wendelstein 7-X device sustained a new peak value of this key fusion parameter for 43 seconds. While high values of fusion triple product have been achieved during plasma durations of a few seconds in devices like JT-60U (Japan, decommissioned in 2008) and JET (Europe), this is a new world record for triple product in long plasma discharges.
"Elevating the triple product to tokamak levels during long plasma pulses marks another important milestone on the way toward a power-plant-capable stellarator," said Thomas Klinger, Head of Operations at Wendelstein 7-X and Head of Stellarator Dynamics and Transport at the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP) in Greifswald, Germany.
According to the
IPP press release
, the triple product world record for long pulses was made possible by the close collaboration between the Wendelstein 7-X team in Greifswald, the European fusion consortium
EUROfusion
, and partners from the United States. A pellet injector developed at the Oak Ridge National Laboratory fuelled the plasma with a steady supply of hydrogen particles and permitted the long plasma durations achieved. Other laboratories in Europe and the United States provided the diagnostics to measure the different factors entering into the triple product calculation.
During the campaign, the team also obtained milestones for energy turnover (maintaining continuous high-energy input and removing the generated heat) and plasma pressure relative to magnetic pressure.
“The records of this experimental campaign are much more than mere numbers," said Robert Wolf, Head of Stellarator Heating and Optimization. "They represent a significant step forward in validating the stellarator concept—made possible through outstanding international collaboration.”
Read the full press release on the IPP website.

data.title: Gemini with Deep Think officially achieves gold-medal standard at the IMO
data.author: meetpateltech
data.article_summary: Google DeepMind's advanced Gemini Deep Think model achieved a gold-medal performance at the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO), solving five out of six problems and scoring 35 points. This marks a significant improvement over the previous year's silver-medal result with AlphaGeometry and AlphaProof. The new model operated entirely in natural language, completing tasks within the 4.5-hour limit, unlike the earlier systems that required translation into formal languages and took days to compute. The success was due to parallel thinking, reinforced learning, and access to high-quality mathematical solutions. While this is a major milestone, Google DeepMind continues to work towards combining natural language fluency with formal reasoning to advance AI's potential in mathematics.
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Gemini模型的数学证明能力及其技术实现细节

不同观点：
• modeless：对Gemini模型内部是否使用了Lean、互联网搜索、计算器或Python等工具表示疑问，并关注计算成本。随后编辑补充确认模型未使用任何工具和互联网。
• kevinventullo：对放弃形式化技术表示失望，认为要真正自动化数学，特别是大规模的数学证明，必须依靠形式化技术，否则仍需人类验证。
• shiandow：认为Gemini的证明比OpenAI的更清晰、简洁，且使用正确的散文格式。
• sanjitb：支持使用任何有助于模型表现的工具，不理解为何不使用定理证明器，并指出Gemini在IMO问题解决上得到了专门训练和数据支持。
• be7a：认为从Lean系统转向更通用的LLM+RL方法可能会提高在数学竞赛之外的表现，并期待这一前沿的进一步发展。
• tornikeo：将当前进展比作"深蓝 vs. 卡斯帕罗夫"时刻，认为虽然距离真正的AI数学家还很远，但这是一个激动人心的时刻。
• Sol-：讨论了并行推理的可能性和计算量问题，认为即使使用大量计算找到解决方案也是了不起的成就。
• irthomasthomas：提到并行推理的想法，并提供相关开源项目链接。
• vouaobrasil：认为这种系统化的数学方法扼杀了数学的乐趣。
• gyrovagueGeist：认为虽然有用且有趣，但在没有连接到形式验证工具的情况下仍可能存在危险，特别是模型可能产生细微的错误。
• Dzugaru：关注Gemini是否能自行验证解决方案的正确性，以及在多轮测试中的表现。
• gundmc：假设Gemini的"高级版本"可能有更多的计算资源或不同的模型。
• neom：对当前进展的重要性和难度表示疑问，并询问接下来可能的发展。
• foota：建议将深度学习模型应用于简单有限群的分类问题，看看是否能提出比1000页更短的解决方案。

补充讨论：
• 计算成本和资源使用是多个评论中提到的关注点，尤其是如果成本过高则可能限制实际应用。

• 对Gemini证明的清晰性和格式有正面评价，但也有对潜在错误的担忧。

44637191.article_content:
Research
Advanced version of Gemini with Deep Think officially achieves gold-medal standard at the International Mathematical Olympiad
Published
21 July 2025
Authors
Thang Luong and Edward Lockhart
Share
Copy link
×
The International Mathematical Olympiad (“IMO”) is the world’s most prestigious competition for young mathematicians, and has been held annually since 1959. Each country taking part is represented by six elite, pre-university mathematicians who compete to solve six exceptionally difficult problems in algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory. Medals are awarded to the top half of contestants, with approximately 8% receiving a prestigious gold medal.
Recently, the IMO has also become an aspirational challenge for AI systems as a test of their advanced mathematical problem-solving and reasoning capabilities. Last year, Google DeepMind’s combined AlphaProof and AlphaGeometry 2 systems
achieved the silver-medal standard
, solving four out of the six problems and scoring 28 points. Making use of specialist formal languages, this breakthrough demonstrated that AI was beginning to approach elite human mathematical reasoning.
This year, we were amongst an inaugural cohort to have our model results officially graded and certified by IMO coordinators using the same criteria as for student solutions. Recognizing the significant accomplishments of this year’s student-participants, we’re now excited to share the news of Gemini’s breakthrough performance.
Breakthrough Performance at IMO 2025 with Gemini Deep Think
An advanced version of Gemini
Deep Think
solved five out of the six IMO problems perfectly, earning 35 total points, and achieving gold-medal level performance. The solutions can be found online
here
.
“
"We can confirm that Google DeepMind has reached the much-desired milestone, earning 35 out of a possible 42 points — a gold medal score. Their solutions were astonishing in many respects. IMO graders found them to be clear, precise and most of them easy to follow."
IMO President Prof. Dr. Gregor Dolinar
This achievement is a significant advance over last year’s breakthrough result. At IMO 2024, AlphaGeometry and AlphaProof required experts to first translate problems from natural language into domain-specific languages, such as Lean, and vice-versa for the proofs. It also took two to three days of computation. This year, our advanced Gemini model operated end-to-end in natural language, producing rigorous mathematical proofs directly from the official problem descriptions – all within the 4.5-hour competition time limit.
Making the most of Deep Think mode
We achieved this year’s result using an advanced version of Gemini Deep Think – an enhanced reasoning mode for complex problems that incorporates some of our latest research techniques, including parallel thinking. This setup enables the model to simultaneously explore and combine multiple possible solutions before giving a final answer, rather than pursuing a single, linear chain of thought.
To make the most of the reasoning capabilities of Deep Think, we additionally trained this version of Gemini on novel reinforcement learning techniques that can leverage more multi-step reasoning, problem-solving and theorem-proving data. We also provided Gemini with access to a curated corpus of high-quality solutions to mathematics problems, and added some general hints and tips on how to approach IMO problems to its instructions.
We will be making a version of this Deep Think model available to a set of trusted testers, including mathematicians, before rolling it out to Google AI Ultra subscribers.
The Future of AI and Mathematics
Google DeepMind has ongoing collaborations with the mathematical community, but we are still only
at the start
of AI’s potential to contribute to mathematics. By teaching our systems to reason more flexibly and intuitively, we are getting closer to building AI that can solve more complex and advanced mathematics.
While our approach this year was based purely on natural language with Gemini, we also continue making progress on our formal systems, AlphaGeometry and AlphaProof. We believe agents that combine natural language fluency with rigorous reasoning - including verified reasoning in formal languages - will become invaluable tools for mathematicians, scientists, engineers, and researchers, helping us advance human knowledge on the path to AGI.
Acknowledgements
We thank the International Mathematical Olympiad organization for their support.
Thang Luong led the overall technical direction of the advanced Gemini model with Deep Think for IMO and co-led with Edward Lockhart on the overall coordination of the IMO 2025 effort.
The IMO 2025 system would not have been possible without the following technical leads. Dawsen Hwang, Junehyuk Jung co-led training data and expert evaluation. Jonathan Lee, Nate Kushman, Pol Moreno, Yi Tay co-led the training of the advanced Gemini Deep Think model while Lei Yu led model evaluation.
44637191.article_summary: Google DeepMind's advanced Gemini Deep Think model achieved a gold-medal performance at the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO), solving five out of six problems and scoring 35 points. This marks a significant improvement over the previous year's silver-medal result with AlphaGeometry and AlphaProof. The new model operated entirely in natural language, completing tasks within the 4.5-hour limit, unlike the earlier systems that required translation into formal languages and took days to compute. The success was due to parallel thinking, reinforced learning, and access to high-quality mathematical solutions. While this is a major milestone, Google DeepMind continues to work towards combining natural language fluency with formal reasoning to advance AI's potential in mathematics.

data.title: Germany's Fairytale Castles Added to UNESCO's World Heritage List
data.author: ulrischa
data.article_summary: 德国巴伐利亚的四座城堡——新天鹅堡、林德霍夫宫、沙琛宫和海伦基姆湖宫——被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录。这些城堡由巴伐利亚国王路德维希二世建造，灵感来自瓦尔特堡、凡尔赛宫、德国童话和作曲家瓦格纳的歌剧。新天鹅堡是德国著名旅游景点，每年吸引约140万游客，甚至启发了迪士尼的睡美人城堡设计。这些城堡采用了现代创新技术，如抽水马桶、内部电话系统和中央供暖。经过近二十年的努力，它们终于被列入世界遗产名录，其中新天鹅堡的王座大厅刚完成耗资2300万美元的翻修。此外，塞拉利昂的戈拉雨林国家公园和蒂怀岛野生动物保护区也首次被列入该名录，成为生物多样性热点。

44637815.article_content:
Neuschwanstein was one of four castles in Bavaria to make the list.
Philippe Clement / Arterra / Universal Images Group via Getty Images
Germany’s storybook castles are now UNESCO World Heritage sites. The royal castles of Neuschwanstein, Linderhof, Schachen and Herrenchiemsee have been
added
to the prestigious list, which includes more than 1,200 sites.
Neuschwanstein Castle
, located near the village of Schwangau in Bavaria, is one of Germany’s most popular tourist sites. Every year, roughly 1.4 million travelers visit the site, reports
Reuters
’ John Revill. In the 1950s, Walt Disney was purportedly so inspired by
Ludwig II
’s grand palace that he modeled
Sleeping Beauty
’s castle after it.
In addition to Neuschwanstein Castle, the UNESCO designation also applies to three other palaces in Bavaria. All were built under Ludwig’s rule, which lasted from 1864 to 1886, though Neuschwanstein was never completed.
Quick fact: Ludwig II’s lavish building projects
The
Bavarian king
was known for his intense focus on artistic pursuits and elaborate construction initiatives, which he prioritized over political matters.
Ludwig used the four castles as “personal retreats and imaginative escapes,” taking design inspiration from the Wartburg Castle in Germany, the Palace of Versailles in France, German fairytales and the operas of German composer Richard Wagner, according to UNESCO.
Neuschwanstein featured many modern innovations, including flushing toilets, an internal telephone system and central heating, per the castle’s
website
.
After Ludwig died in 1886, the sites were opened to the public. Today, they continue to be accessible to visitors as museums and cultural landmarks.
Efforts have been underway to get the castles included on UNESCO’s World Heritage list for nearly two decades, per the London
Times
’ David Crossland. The Throne Hall inside Neuschwanstein Castle recently underwent a five-year
renovation
that cost roughly $23 million.
“For our fairytale castles, a fairytale comes true,” says Markus Soeder, a German politician representing Bavaria, in a statement shared with Reuters.
Linderhof Castle in Bavaria, Germany
Education Images / Universal Images Group via Getty Images
Members of the UNESCO World Heritage Committee
voted to add
more than two dozen sites to the list during the group’s July meeting in Paris. Other new inductees include mysterious
granite megaliths
in Brittany, France, and
petroglyphs
along the Bangucheon Stream in South Korea.
The West African nation of Sierra Leone gained its first-ever UNESCO World Heritage site with the inclusion of its Gola Rainforest National Park and the Tiwai Island Wildlife Sanctuary. Together, the
two locations
form a “biodiversity hotspot” that’s home to more than 1,000 plant species, 55 mammal species and 448 bird species, per UNESCO.
Measuring just 4.5 square miles, Tiwai Island alone is home to 11 species of primates, including the endangered
Diana monkey
.
“I feel very happy, relieved, hopeful,” says Tommy Garnett, the 66-year-old activist and environmentalist who spearheaded the UNESCO push for Tiwai Island, to Lucie Peytermann and Saidu Bah of
Agence France-Presse
.

data.title: Game Genie Retrospective: The Best NES Accessory Ever Was Unlicensed
data.author: coloneltcb
data.article_summary: 本文回顾了Game Genie这一游戏修改工具的35年历史及其对游戏行业的深远影响。Game Genie于1990年推出，通过输入代码可改变任天堂游戏的难度和特性，受到玩家欢迎，但也引发了与任天堂的法律纠纷。尽管任天堂认为该设备侵权并提起诉讼，最终法院裁定Game Genie合法，因为它仅临时修改游戏显示而不永久改变游戏内容。这一裁决不仅奠定了修改工具的合法性，还成为近年来涉及人工智能和版权争议的重要法律 precedent。Game Genie的发明者David Darling也因其贡献被授予大英帝国勋章。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Game Genie的功能、影响以及相关技术对游戏和玩家的意义

不同观点：
• **Game Genie增强了游戏探索性和趣味性**：[freedomben]认为Game Genie通过提供各种游戏修改选项，增加了游戏的趣味性和探索性，而不仅仅是简单的“作弊”。他和朋友通过调整游戏参数获得了乐趣，并认为这是他首次体验到技术创新的魅力。

• **现代游戏更依赖于 progression mechanics，而非游戏机制本身**：[j_timberlake]指出，现代游戏如果使用Game Genie获得最高属性可能会破坏游戏体验，因为这些游戏的趣味性更多依赖于逐步解锁的机制，而非单纯的游戏机制。此外，他认为任天堂没有推出类似设备是放弃了容易获得的收入。

• **Game Genie对计算机科学的启蒙作用**：[minimaxir]认为Game Genie通过让孩子们接触到内存地址和十六进制编码，成为了90年代和00年代孩子们接触计算机科学的启蒙工具。他自己的经历表明，Game Genie激发了对技术背后的原理的兴趣，甚至影响了部分人的职业选择。

• **Codemasters制作Game Genie和优秀赛车游戏的矛盾**：[OliveMate]对Codemasters这家公司制作了Game Genie的同时也开发了顶级赛车游戏表示不解，并对公司未来的发展表示担忧，尤其是考虑到EA对公司的掌控逐渐加强。

• **Game Genie帮助玩家克服游戏困难**：[mousethatroared]强调Game Genie允许玩家通过修改参数来克服游戏中的困难关卡。

• **怀旧情绪与Game Genie的历史地位**：[tmnstr85]表达了对Game Genie和类似设备（如PS1、PS2模组）的怀旧情绪，认为那是游戏历史上一个伟大的时代。

• **对文章写作方式的不满**：[CursedSilicon]批评了相关文章的叙述方式，认为文章试图强行将Game Genie与现代AI技术联系起来，而没有专注于Game Genie自身的优点。

• **与其他平台修改工具的比较**：[TacticalCoder]将Game Genie与Commodore 64上的"Final Cartridge"或"Power Cartridge"进行类比，认为它们在功能上类似，都是通过修改内存来调整游戏参数。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是Game Genie是否应被视为“作弊工具”还是“探索工具”。[freedomben]和[j_timberlake]在这个问题上存在潜在的不同看法，前者强调了探索和乐趣，而后者则关注现代游戏的结构和Game Genie可能带来的负面影响。
• 另一个讨论点是Game Genie对技术启蒙的贡献，[minimaxir]强调了其在计算机科学教育方面的潜在影响。
• 最后，[OliveMate]和[CursedSilicon]分别对Codemasters的未来和文章写作质量表达了个人看法，虽然这些并不是核心技术讨论，但为整体讨论增添了多样性。

Hey all, Ernie here with a bigger refresh than usual. In honor of the Game Genie’s 35th anniversary this month, here’s a deeply rewritten version of a 2015 Tedium piece on the device. Nearly every section has been completely rebuilt wholesale. Something happened very recently that makes this classic device relevant to the current moment. Can you guess what it is?
Today in Tedium:
July 1990, a full 35 years ago, was supposed to be the coming-out party for one of the best accessories ever created for the Nintendo Entertainment System. It made games easier, sure, but it also made them more interesting. It presented a new way of thinking about the games that you brought home. But Nintendo didn’t like it—and the company sued. That device eventually emerged, and despite the legal battle, it became a defining part of what made the NES great. I am of course talking about the Game Genie, whose legacy looms large today. Today’s Tedium ponders why the Game Genie proved such a defining piece of video game history.
— Ernie @ Tedium
“We didn’t have a license to create Nintendo games so we found a way of bypassing Nintendo’s lock-out chip and released games that way. We had an idea of placing a switch on the cartridge to add extra lives, weapons, and things like that. Then we made the mental leap of saying that if we could do this with our own games, then maybe we could build an interface for other people’s games too. It was a game that morphed into an industry.”
— David Darling,
one of the founders of Codemasters, the British gaming company that first created the Game Genie in the late 1980s,
discussing how the device came to be
in a 2015 interview with the now-defunct
GamesTM
. Darling, who produced dozens of games over the years—most notably
the
Dizzy
series
—eventually licensed the idea to Galoob, a major American toy company that started selling the NES version of the device in mid-1990. They eventually turned the hacky device concept
into a $140 million cottage industry
. For creating the Game Genie and helping develop the British gaming industry, David Darling, along with his brother Richard,
were made Commanders of the Order of the British Empire
back in 2008. See, even the queen noticed!
The appeals court case that legalized the Game Genie was recently used to claim that Anthropic’s LLMs are fair use
The idea of a video game console
like the Nintendo Entertainment System is that it’s a console, not a computer. In a perfect world, you’re not supposed to see the wires holding together the games.
But the Game Genie exposed them to the world, in batches of six or eight characters, and that made the device both dangerous to Nintendo and extremely appealing to your average eight-year-old.
Of course they were going to butt heads over it, and it feels like a situation that, one look at the legal battle between the two, has a lot of modern parallels. In fact, the legal battle between the two companies was recently cited in a landmark appeals court ruling involving the LLM provider Anthropic.
Yes, we live in a world where we can directly compare Claude siphoning the whole of human knowledge with the six- or eight-character codes you put into your NES in 1991.
The saga began in May 1990, when the device’s U.S. distributor, Lewis Galoob Toys, sued Nintendo, seeking declaratory relief against Nintendo, in hopes that a court could tell them the Game Genie was safe to sell. It was not clear if Galoob would win, and at first, they didn’t.
(It should be noted that another way this story has relevance to the modern day is via trade. See, while the Game Genie was temporarily banned in the U.S. because of the lawsuit, it had gone on sale in Canada, where a
separate legal battle
quickly
fell out of Nintendo’s hands
. If you knew someone going to Toronto, it was presumably easy to get one across the border. It wasn’t like this device was contraband.)
The early rounds of the case did not go Galoob’s way, with a preliminary injunction preventing the device from being sold.
But like a quick-witted Micro Machines pitchman
, Galoob ultimately got the last word in: The federal district court eventually favored Galoob’s stance, and when an appeals court decided to take the case on in 1992, it was bad for Nintendo.
In his decision, Joseph Jerome Farris found that slight modifications of a derivative work were allowed, as long as the original form of copyright was kept intact.
“The Game Genie merely enhances the audiovisual displays (or underlying data bytes) that originate in Nintendo game cartridges,“
the legal decision states
. “The altered displays do not incorporate a portion of a copyrighted work in some concrete or permanent form.”
The ruling created a pliable standard for derivative works.
Very quickly, the ruling became an important one in the history of fair use. It also raised some legal precedent regarding wheth
44638300.article_summary: 本文回顾了Game Genie这一游戏修改工具的35年历史及其对游戏行业的深远影响。Game Genie于1990年推出，通过输入代码可改变任天堂游戏的难度和特性，受到玩家欢迎，但也引发了与任天堂的法律纠纷。尽管任天堂认为该设备侵权并提起诉讼，最终法院裁定Game Genie合法，因为它仅临时修改游戏显示而不永久改变游戏内容。这一裁决不仅奠定了修改工具的合法性，还成为近年来涉及人工智能和版权争议的重要法律 precedent。Game Genie的发明者David Darling也因其贡献被授予大英帝国勋章。
44638300.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Game Genie的功能、影响以及相关技术对游戏和玩家的意义

不同观点：
• **Game Genie增强了游戏探索性和趣味性**：[freedomben]认为Game Genie通过提供各种游戏修改选项，增加了游戏的趣味性和探索性，而不仅仅是简单的“作弊”。他和朋友通过调整游戏参数获得了乐趣，并认为这是他首次体验到技术创新的魅力。

• **现代游戏更依赖于 progression mechanics，而非游戏机制本身**：[j_timberlake]指出，现代游戏如果使用Game Genie获得最高属性可能会破坏游戏体验，因为这些游戏的趣味性更多依赖于逐步解锁的机制，而非单纯的游戏机制。此外，他认为任天堂没有推出类似设备是放弃了容易获得的收入。

• **Game Genie对计算机科学的启蒙作用**：[minimaxir]认为Game Genie通过让孩子们接触到内存地址和十六进制编码，成为了90年代和00年代孩子们接触计算机科学的启蒙工具。他自己的经历表明，Game Genie激发了对技术背后的原理的兴趣，甚至影响了部分人的职业选择。

• **Codemasters制作Game Genie和优秀赛车游戏的矛盾**：[OliveMate]对Codemasters这家公司制作了Game Genie的同时也开发了顶级赛车游戏表示不解，并对公司未来的发展表示担忧，尤其是考虑到EA对公司的掌控逐渐加强。

• **Game Genie帮助玩家克服游戏困难**：[mousethatroared]强调Game Genie允许玩家通过修改参数来克服游戏中的困难关卡。

• **怀旧情绪与Game Genie的历史地位**：[tmnstr85]表达了对Game Genie和类似设备（如PS1、PS2模组）的怀旧情绪，认为那是游戏历史上一个伟大的时代。

• **对文章写作方式的不满**：[CursedSilicon]批评了相关文章的叙述方式，认为文章试图强行将Game Genie与现代AI技术联系起来，而没有专注于Game Genie自身的优点。

• **与其他平台修改工具的比较**：[TacticalCoder]将Game Genie与Commodore 64上的"Final Cartridge"或"Power Cartridge"进行类比，认为它们在功能上类似，都是通过修改内存来调整游戏参数。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是Game Genie是否应被视为“作弊工具”还是“探索工具”。[freedomben]和[j_timberlake]在这个问题上存在潜在的不同看法，前者强调了探索和乐趣，而后者则关注现代游戏的结构和Game Genie可能带来的负面影响。
• 另一个讨论点是Game Genie对技术启蒙的贡献，[minimaxir]强调了其在计算机科学教育方面的潜在影响。

data.title: Modern Debian-based Window Maker distribution
data.author: Aldipower
data.article_summary: Window Maker Live 12.8 已经发布，该版本基于 Debian Bookworm，采用 Window Maker 作为默认窗口管理器，提供一致的视觉体验。它集成了 XFCE4、MATE、LXQT 等组件，特别关注 GNUstep。新版本编号方案改为强调与 Debian Bookworm 的关系。Window Maker Live 可作为 Debian 的替代安装介质，兼容 Bookworm 仓库以获取安全更新和修复。ISO 映像支持17种欧洲语言，可用于硬盘安装。下载和自定义构建文件可从 SourceForge 获取，捐赠有助于支持项目发展。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：NeXTSTEP-like桌面环境及其相关项目（如WindowMaker、wmlive）的使用和评价

不同观点：
• [felixding等支持者观点] 强调NeXTSTEP风格桌面环境的项目（如NextSpace、GS-Desktop）值得关注，提供了与NeXTSTEP类似的体验，并分享了相关项目链接。
• [kev009的怀旧观点] 认为NeXTSTEP的用户界面虽然起初看起来奇怪，但随着时间推移显得很有韵味，尤其是对于从Mac OS Classic和Win9x成长起来的用户。
• [_fat_santa的实用性关注] 关心WindowMaker与现代应用程序的兼容性，并询问是否有人将其作为日常驱动使用。
• [chrsw的理想化系统] 表达了对基于GNUstep的完整系统的期望，类似于Mac的开放源代码替代方案，包含应用商店和客户支持。
• [indrora的经验分享] 长期以来希望有更好的WindowMaker体验，并认为NeXT的解决方案比以前的.so混乱更理想。
• [karmakaze的使用体验] 提到NeXTSTEP和WindowMaker的左侧滚动条设计独特，但对文件浏览器中的三列设计感到困惑。
• [zem的怀旧情绪] 对WindowMaker感到怀旧，曾想为其编写库但未实现，最终转向了其他桌面环境。
• [Koshkin的Unix用户视角] 认为WindowMaker对Unix用户来说显得陌生，更喜欢CDE或TWM，认为它们更接近Windows体验。

补充讨论：
• [indigodaddy的触屏适应性问题] 好奇这些项目是否适用于触屏或平板设备。
• [esseph和gigel82对SourceForge的评论] 对SourceForge网站的生存表示惊讶，并提到其曾因引入恶意软件而声誉受损。
• [wmlive维护者的详细说明] 强调wmlive更像是一个基于WindowMaker的Debian发行版，提供了预配置的环境和完整软件包，旨在为有经验的用户提供灵活的系统救援和修复工具，而非针对初学者或NeXT怀旧者。

争议焦点：
• WindowMaker与现代应用程序的兼容性及其作为日常驱动使用的可行性。
• wmlive项目的目标和定位，特别是它与GNUstep和NeXTSTEP风格界面的关系，以及其主要用户群体（怀旧者与Linux经验用户）的定位差异。

44637151.article_content:
Window Maker Live 12.8 is available
sourceforge.net/projects/wmlive/files/wmlive-bookworm-12.8/
Current Window Maker Live version is 12.8
The former versioning scheme based on Window Maker's version number has
been changed to emphasize the close relationship to the version of
Debian/Bookwom on which the project is ultimately based.
What is Window Maker Live?
Window Maker Live is an installable Linux Live ISO based on the current Bookworm branch of Debian.  The system uses the
Window Maker
window manager as its default graphical user interface. Window Maker Live's components have been carefully preconfigured and the desktop environment has a consistent visual appearance. Window Maker Live integrates selected components from other desktop environments such as XFCE4, MATE, LXQT, with a particular focus on GNUstep.
It can also be considered as an alternative installation medium for Debian and is fully compatible with the official Debian/Bookworm repositories for security updates and bug fixes.
Ready-made Window Maker Live CD ISO images for download
You can find the most recent ISO image releases for download at
sourceforge.net/projects/wmlive/files/wmlive-bookworm-12.8/
.
These ISO images currently support 17 European languages most used worldwide.
As these ISO images are basically standard Live Debian installation
media, they work just fine for installation to hard disk, and can
therefore be used to bootstrap a new system.
The current
wmlive-bookworm-12.8.tar.xz
archive contains the necessary material to build the Window Maker Live
ISO images with the Debian Live Build system on your own.
The package assortment used is largely based on the current stable
("bookworm") branch of the Debian archive, with only a few selected
packages recompiled by ourselves.
Please consider a donation to support and speed up our work on wmlive
Donate at
www.paypal.me/wmlive
(make sure to choose "sending money to family or friends").

data.title: SecretSpec: Declarative Secrets Management
data.author: domenkozar
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了一种名为 **SecretSpec** 的声明式秘密管理工具，旨在解决传统 `.env` 文件管理秘密时的多个问题，如安全性不足、解析不一致、跨平台集成困难等。SecretSpec 将秘密管理分为三个关注点：**WHAT**（应用程序需要哪些秘密）、**HOW**（秘密的要求和验证）、**WHERE**（秘密的存储位置），并通过一个简单的 TOML 文件来声明这些秘密。不同环境（如开发、CI、生产）可以使用不同的秘密存储供应商（如 Keychain、AWS Secrets Manager），而无需更改应用代码。SecretSpec 提供了统一的秘密管理方式，解决了 `.env` 文件的局限性和潜在安全问题，适合各类团队使用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：秘密和配置管理的方法与工具选择

不同观点：
• imglorp认为LastPass不安全，自2011年以来已被入侵七次，建议避免使用。他主张减少对LastPass的依赖，以提升网络安全。
• theozero介绍了一个新工具Varlock，强调其在.env文件中添加元数据和使用DSL "env-spec"的方法。该工具旨在处理所有配置而不仅是秘密，并计划推出允许从不同后端提取特定项目的插件系统。
• dayjah关心秘密在存储中的引用方式，特别是在OnePassword中的实现细节，后来通过参考文档解决了疑问。
• kevmo314质疑Secretspec的必要性，认为其CI/CD示例并没有明显优于传统的cat命令写入.env文件的方法，尤其是在秘密轮换和信任问题上。
• aranelsurion提出Teller作为另一种选择，介绍其使用YAML配置和从AWS/GCP等远程服务获取秘密的功能。
• tgbugs分享了自己实现的python库，强调了将秘密与常规配置分离在实际应用中的困难，并指出透明集成加密秘密存储的复杂性。
• dvtkrlbs赞赏Secretspec的附加功能，如Rust示例中的secretspec_derive，但提到目前使用Infisical遇到的一些限制。
• JadoJodo对将加密秘密提交到Git仓库的正常化表示怀疑，并询问是否有实际工作环境鼓励这种做法。
• sofixa强烈反对分散的秘密管理方式，主张集中管理以避免秘密失控和安全风险，并推荐使用Vault/OpenBao等工具实现集中管理。

补充讨论：
• 0xbadcafebee深入探讨了配置值和基础设施模式，强调静态与动态配置的区别，以及使用不可变基础设施和基础设施即代码的重要性，以避免生产环境中的不一致和潜在漏洞。
• 讨论中多次提到秘密管理的复杂性和安全边界问题，反映了在开发和生产环境中实现有效秘密管理的挑战。
• 社区对不同工具和方法的接受度和信任问题也被多次提及，显示出建立通用标准和广泛应用的必要性。

争议焦点：
• LastPass的安全性及其在秘密管理中的适用性。
• 分散秘密管理与集中秘密管理的优劣对比，尤其是在团队协作和安全控制方面的影响。
• Secretspec等新工具是否提供了显著优于传统方法的优势，特别是在CI/CD环境中的应用。

44636691.article_content:
Announcing SecretSpec: Declarative Secrets Management
We've supported
.env integration
for managing secrets, but it has several issues:
Apps are disconnected from their secrets
- applications lack a clear contract about which secrets they need
Parsing
.env
is unclear
- comments, multiline values, and special characters all have ambiguous behavior across different parsers
Password manager integration is difficult
- requiring manual copy-paste or template workarounds
Vendor lock-in
- applications use custom parsing logic, making it hard to switch providers
No encryption
-
.env
files are stored as plain text, vulnerable to accidental commits or unauthorized access
While we could recommend solutions like
dotenvx
to encrypt
.env
files or
sops
for general secret encryption, these bring new challenges:
Don't you feel some anxiety given we've normalized committing encrypted secrets to git repos?
— Domen Kožar (@domenkozar)
July 18, 2025
Single key management
- requires distributing and managing a master key
Trust requirements
- everyone with the key can decrypt all secrets
Rotation complexity
- departing team members require key rotation and re-encrypting all secrets
Larger teams often adopt solutions like
OpenBao
(the open source fork of HashiCorp Vault), requiring significant infrastructure and operational overhead. Smaller teams face a gap between simple
.env
files and complex enterprise solutions.
What if instead of choosing one tool, we declared secrets uniformly and let each environment use its best provider?
The Hidden Problem: Conflating Three Concerns
We've created
SecretSpec
and integrated it into devenv. SecretSpec separates secret management into three distinct concerns:
WHAT
- Which secrets does your application need? (DATABASE_URL, API_KEY)
HOW
- Requirements (required vs optional, defaults, validation, environment)
WHERE
- Where are these secrets stored? (environment variables, Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)
By separating these concerns, your
application declares what secrets it needs
in a simple TOML file. Each
developer, CI system, and production environment
can provide those secrets from their
preferred secure storage
-
without changing any application code
.
One Spec, Multiple Environments, Different Providers
Imagine you commit a
secretspec.toml
file that declares:
# secretspec.toml - committed to your repo
[project]
name
=
"my-app"
revision
=
"1.0"
[profiles.default]
DATABASE_URL
=
{
description
=
"PostgreSQL connection string"
,
required
=
true
}
REDIS_URL
=
{
description
=
"Redis connection string"
,
required
=
false
}
STRIPE_API_KEY
=
{
description
=
"Stripe API key"
,
required
=
true
}
[profiles.development]
# Inherits from default profile - only override what changes
DATABASE_URL
=
{
default
=
"postgresql://localhost/myapp_dev"
}
REDIS_URL
=
{
default
=
"redis://localhost:6379"
}
STRIPE_API_KEY
=
{
description
=
"Stripe API key (test mode)"
}
[profiles.production]
# Production keeps strict requirements from default profile
Now, here's the magic:
You
(on macOS): Store it in Keychain, retrieve with
secretspec --provider keyring run -- cmd args
Your teammate
(on Linux): Store it in GNOME Keyring, same command works
That one developer
: Still uses a
.env
file locally (we don't judge, we've been there)
CI/CD
: Reads from environment variables in GitHub Actions
secretspec --provider env run -- cmd args
Production
: Secrets get provisioned using AWS Secret Manager
Same specification. Different providers. Zero code changes.
Example: One Spec, Three Environments
Let's walk through migrating from
.env
to SecretSpec.
Setting up secretspec for development
First, choose your default provider and profile:
$
secretspec
config
init
? Select your preferred provider backend:
> keyring: Uses system keychain (Recommended)
onepassword: OnePassword password manager
dotenv: Traditional .env files
env: Read-only environment variables
lastpass: LastPass password manager
? Select your default profile:
> development
default
none
✓ Configuration saved to ~/.config/secretspec/config.toml
Importing secrets
Create
secretspec.toml
from your existing
.env
:
$
secretspec
init
--from
dotenv
1. Local Development with devenv (You're on macOS)
Enable SecretSpec in
devenv.yaml
:
secretspec
:
enable
:
true
In
devenv.nix
:
{
pkgs
,
lib
,
config
,
...
}:
{
services
.
minio
=
{
enable
=
true
;
buckets
=
[
config
.
secretspec
.
secrets
.
BUCKET_NAME
];
};
}

44636691.article_summary: 文章介绍了一种名为 **SecretSpec** 的声明式秘密管理工具，旨在解决传统 `.env` 文件管理秘密时的多个问题，如安全性不足、解析不一致、跨平台集成困难等。SecretSpec 将秘密管理分为三个关注点：**WHAT**（应用程序需要哪些秘密）、**HOW**（秘密的要求和验证）、**WHERE**（秘密的存储位置），并通过一个简单的 TOML 文件来声明这些秘密。不同环境（如开发、CI、生产）可以使用不同的秘密存储供应商（如 Keychain、AWS Secrets Manager），而无需更改应用代码。SecretSpec 提供了统一的秘密管理方式，解决了 `.env` 文件的局限性和潜在安全问题，适合各类团队使用。

data.title: Memory Efficiency in iOS: Reducing footprint and beyond
data.author: CharlesW
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：iOS应用开发中的内存管理和代码依赖问题

不同观点：
• **potatolicious** 认为，控制应用二进制文件的大小对于内存管理至关重要。他指出，许多开发者在处理依赖项时缺乏考虑，导致应用二进制文件过大，尤其是在使用静态链接时。他建议谨慎选择依赖项，尽可能动态链接，并积极进行无用代码剥离（deadstrip）。

• **nfriedly** 提到，iOS 18及以上版本似乎更频繁地发出低内存警告，即使应用使用的内存不到设备RAM的一半。他推测这可能是因为操作系统自身（如AI功能）占用了更多内存。

• **ksec** 感叹iOS在过去更注重内存效率，而现在应用体积逐年增大，响应速度也受到影响。

• **conradev** 强调了图片加载对内存的影响，建议使用懒加载策略，并比较了不同图片库的效率。他特别提到FastImageCache虽然高效，但技术过时，建议结合现代技术进行改进。

• **tomovo** 对potatolicious提到的内存优化效果表示兴趣，希望看到具体的数据对比。同时，对Lottie加载帧的方式提出质疑，认为Lottie应该直接渲染矢量数据而非位图。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：potatolicious和tomovo之间就Lottie的渲染方式存在争议。potatolicious认为Lottie加载每一帧为位图导致内存消耗，而tomovo则认为Lottie应直接渲染矢量数据。

• **重要论据**：
  - potatolicious指出静态链接和依赖项管理不善是导致应用体积增大的主要原因。
  - nfriedly和ksec都观察到iOS系统本身在内存管理上的变化，可能导致应用面临更多的内存压力。
  - conradev提供了关于图片加载的具体技术建议，强调了不同库之间的效率差异。

• **其他值得注意的讨论点**：
  - 开发者在选择依赖项时需要权衡其功能价值与对内存和应用体积的影响。
  - 无用代码剥离和动态链接是减少应用体积和内存消耗的重要技术手段。
  - 图片加载和缓存策略对内存管理有显著影响，选择合适的库可以有效提升应用性能。

data.title: Show HN: Pogocache – Fast caching software
data.author: tidwall
data.article_summary: Pogocache是一款专注于低延迟和高CPU效率的快速缓存软件，性能优于Memcache、Valkey、Redis等。它具有低延迟、高扩展性，支持从单线程到多线程的优化，减少CPU占用和运营成本。Pogocache可作为服务器运行，支持Memcache、Valkey/Redis、HTTP和Postgres等协议，并可通过curl、psql等工具连接。它还支持嵌入式使用，提供超过100M ops/秒的速度。软件在64位Linux和MacOS上设计和测试，具有多种安全和高级选项，如TLS、身份验证和哈希算法优化等。

Pogocache is fast caching software built from scratch with a focus on low latency and cpu efficency.
Faster
: Pogocache is faster than Memcache, Valkey, Redis, Dragonfly, and Garnet.
It has the lowest latency per request, providing the quickest response times.
It's optimized to scale from one to many cores, giving you the best single-threaded and multithreaded performance.
Cheaper
: Pogocache uses the fewest cpu cycles per request; minimizing server load, energy usage, and the overall cost to operate.
Easier
: Pogocache runs as a server-based program.
It supports Memcache, Valkey/Redis, HTTP, and Postgres wire protocols,
allowing for the use of system tools such as curl and psql, and numerous client libraries that are available for most programming languages.
Embeddable
: Optionally instead of running Pogocache as a server-based program,
the self-contained pogocache.c file can be compiled into existing software,
bypassing the network and directly accessing the cache programmatically.
Running embedded provides raw speed, with over 100M ops per second.
The above benchmarks measure the performance of Pogocache against other caching
software running 8 threads on an AWS c8g.8xlarge.
Visit
https://github.com/tidwall/cache-benchmarks
to see more benchmarks.
Table of contents
Gettng started

Embeddable
Design details
Roadmap and status
License
Support
Getting started
Pogocache is designed and tested on 64-bit Linux and MacOS.
Building
make
This will build the
pogocache
program
Running
./pogocache
This will start the server on localhost (127.0.0.1) port 9401.
To allow connections from other machines, bind the listener to an accessible
host address.
./pogocache -h 172.30.2.84
See all Pogocache program options
The help menu displayed on a Linux server with 32 CPUs.
./pogocache --help
Usage: pogocache [options]
Basic options:
-h hostname            listening host                 (default: 127.0.0.1)
-p port                listening port                 (default: 9401)
-s socket              unix socket file               (default: none)
-v,-vv,-vvv            verbose logging level
Additional options:
--threads count        number of threads              (default: 32)
--maxmemory value      set max memory usage           (default: 80%)
--evict yes/no         evict keys at maxmemory        (default: yes)
--persist path         persistence file               (default: none)
--maxconns conns       maximum connections            (default: 1024)
Security options:
--auth passwd          auth token or password         (default: none)
--tlsport port         enable tls on port             (default: none)
--tlscert certfile     tls cert file                  (default: none)
--tlskey keyfile       tls key file                   (default: none)
--tlscacert cacertfile tls ca-cert file               (default: none)
Advanced options:
--shards count         number of shards               (default: 4096)
--backlog count        accept backlog                 (default: 1024)
--queuesize count      event queuesize size           (default: 128)
--reuseport yes/no     reuseport for tcp              (default: no)
--tcpnodelay yes/no    disable nagles algo            (default: yes)
--quickack yes/no      use quickack (linux)           (default: no)
--uring yes/no         use uring (linux)              (default: yes)
--loadfactor percent   hashmap load factor            (default: 75)
--keysixpack yes/no    sixpack compress keys          (default: yes)
--cas yes/no           use compare and store          (default: no)
Connecting
A variety of tools may be used to connect to Pogocache.
This includes
valkey-cli
,
redis-cli
,
psql
, and
curl
.
Telnet is also available, which uses the
Memcache
interface.
Here's an example using curl
$ curl -X PUT -d
"
my value
"
http://localhost:9401/mykey
Stored
$ curl http://localhost:9401/mykey
my value
$ curl -X DELETE http://localhost:9401/mykey
Deleted
Here's an example using a RESP (Valkey/Redis) client.
$ valkey-cli -p 9401
>
SET mykey value
OK
>
GET mykey

my value
"
>
DEL mykey

psql -h localhost -p 9401

my value
'
;

>

;

;

data.title: Solar+storage is so much farther along than you think
data.author: mooreds
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了太阳能加储能技术的快速发展及其成本的显著下降。根据Ember智库的最新报告，太阳能加储能现在能够以低于新建核能甚至天然气的成本，为阳光充足的城市提供基础负荷电力。例如，拉斯维加斯98%的电力需求可以通过太阳能加储能满足，成本为104美元/兆瓦时，而60%的需求满足成本仅为65美元/兆瓦时，比天然气更便宜。尽管许多人认为储能成本高昂，但近年来电池价格已大幅下降，尤其是过去一年中下降了40%。即便是一些能源行业的专业人士也未能跟上这一快速变化的趋势。文章强调，太阳能加储能的经济性已经达到了可以替代传统能源的水平，政策制定者和公用事业公司需要认识到这一现实并做出相应调整。
data.comments_summary:

不同观点：
• **清洁能源的进展显著**：[trunnell] 提到加州的电力供应情况，指出电池储能在满足峰值需求方面已取代了过去由天然气承担的角色，显示出显著进步。
• **清洁能源成本仍较高**：[Aurornis] 承认太阳能和电池的成本仍高于天然气，但认为价格在下降，政治因素（如关税和政策变化）是当前的主要障碍。

I chat with Kostantsa Rangelova and Dave Jones, authors of a new Ember report, who find that solar-plus-storage costs have declined so much that it can now provide baseload-level power in sunny cities for less than the cost of new nuclear or even new gas. We discuss why even energy pros are behind the curve on this, how quickly the technology is improving, and why most of the world doesn't see natural gas as a viable option the way the US does.

Greetings, everyone. This is Volts for July 16, 2025, "Solar+storage are so much farther along than you think." I'm your host, David Roberts. As anyone who follows energy debates knows, the biggest and most immediate objection to solar power is always: the sun doesn't shine at night. Here's the thing, though: it is possible to attach batteries to solar panels that will store some of their power during the day and release it at night. If you attach enough batteries to a solar panel, you can spread its output over an entire day.
Voilà: a 24/7 "baseload" source of power. Problem solved, right?
Subscribe
Well, no, skeptics argue. By the time you've added the cost of batteries to the cost of solar panels, the power plant becomes too expensive to compete.
In their defense, skeptics were correct about this until very recently. But, as I say over and over again on this pod, solar and batteries are both getting cheaper so consistently and so quickly that it is literally difficult to keep up. Even energy professionals have trouble keeping up.
Kostantsa Rangelova and Dave Jones
And that brings us to a
new white paper
from the energy researchers at Ember. It takes the current price of batteries — which is, incidentally, down 40% in the last year alone — and runs the numbers on how costly it would be to power various sunny cities in the world purely on solar+storage.

Share
Today I'm excited to discuss these and other jaw-dropping findings with the paper's authors, Kostantsa Rangelova and Dave Jones. We are going to get into just how cheap batteries are now, what it means for gas, and why utilities and policymakers need to catch up with the current reality.
All right then, Kostantsa Rangelova and Dave Jones, welcome to Volts. Thank you so much for coming.
Dave Jones
Thank you, David.
Kostantsa Rangelova
Thank you for inviting us.
David Roberts
So you guys have this new report out about solar+storage. The idea of solar+storage, I think, is well understood now among energy types, the Volts audience. But the reason I wanted to do this, and I suspect the reason you wanted to write this report right now, is that things are changing on the ground quickly.
Kostantsa Rangelova
Oh yes.
David Roberts
In this area like this, you really, like, your analysis is out of date by the time you've done it, practically. So I really don't think even people inside our world fully appreciate what's going on. Absolutely. And you're right in saying our starting point was, "Okay, batteries are getting so incredibly cheap now that this probably changes everything around solar and battery economics." data.title: Amazon and the “Profitless Business Model” Fallacy
data.author: serviette
data.article_summary: 本文主要讨论了对亚马逊商业模式的常见误解，特别是其盈利能力和持续投资策略。作者曾于1997-2004年在亚马逊工作，他指出亚马逊采用固定成本商业模式，利用互联网最大化其固定资产的杠杆效应。虽然某些单品可能亏损销售，但绝大多数产品是盈利的。亚马逊通过市场平台和其他零售业务实现盈利，但其巨额投资（如扩建物流中心）导致持续的季度亏损和自由现金流下降。这些投资旨在支持其全球零售扩张的雄心，以实现更大规模的业务增长。尽管外界常质疑亚马逊不赚钱，但其商业模式本质上是盈利的，只是公司选择积极投资未来。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对亚马逊的商业模式、盈利能力及其未来发展的不同看法

不同观点：
• **[metabagel]** 指出文章已经过时，建议更新标题标注发布时间为2013年。
• **[JCM9]** 认为亚马逊虽然通过将大量现金流回业务中取得了成功，但现在面临一些非盈利部门的膨胀问题。特别是AWS业务，虽然有一定调整，但缺乏除核心服务外的清晰战略。
• **[I_dream_of_Geni]** 强调，尽管文章过时，但杰夫·贝索斯的个人财富大幅增长，说明亚马逊整体是盈利的，尤其是对贝索斯个人而言。
• **[aaronbrethorst]** 简单附和，再次指出文章发布时间为2013年。
• **[CGMthrowaway]** 试图总结文章核心观点，认为主要是讲"从固定成本的商业模式开始，将所有收益再投资于增长和扩展"，并询问是否有其他遗漏的要点。
• **[a_c]** 表示过去的自己无法理解这篇文章，暗示随着时间推移，自己的理解发生了变化，可能是因为亚马逊的战略逐渐清晰或自身认知提升。
• **[typs]** 认为这篇文章的分析与某些AI公司的现状类似，暗指这种商业模式在科技行业中具有普遍性。
• **[troupo]** 指出，亚马逊在不断扩展市场（如AWS）或失败（如Alexa）的同时，仍然产生大量现金流。同时批评行业内普遍忽视利润，只关注营收，目标变成通过投资者资金进行价格战和不正当竞争，最终寻求出售或垄断市场。
• **[pengaru]** 简短评论“营收解决所有问题”，暗示对过度关注营收而不注重利润的商业策略的认可或讽刺。

补充讨论：
• 评论中多次提到文章过时的问题，但对亚马逊商业模式的讨论依然具有现实意义，尤其是在AWS的战略调整和整体盈利能力方面。
• 关于亚马逊未来发展的争议焦点在于其非盈利部门的膨胀和AWS战略的清晰性，部分评论者对亚马逊未来能否持续盈利表示担忧。
• 讨论还涉及更广泛的行业趋势，特别是科技公司普遍忽视利润、关注营收和投资者资金支持的商业模式。

44612643.article_content:
[DISCLOSURE: As always when I write about Amazon, I'll note I worked there from 1997-2004 and that I still own some shares in the company. I still have many friends who work there, though I have no more idea what Amazon is working on now than any of you in the public.]
With every quarterly earnings call,
my Twitter feed lights up with jokes about how Amazon continues to grow its revenue and make no profits
and how trusting investors continue to rewards the company for it. The apotheosis of that line of thoughts is a
quote
from Slate's Matthew Yglesias earlier this year: "Amazon, as best I can tell, is a charitable organization being run by elements of the investment community for the benefit of consumers."
It's a great quote, one that got so much play Amazon even featured it in its Annual Letter to Shareholders.
But like much of the commentary about Amazon, it's a misreading of Amazon's business model.
Amazon is a classic fixed cost business model, it uses the internet to get maximum leverage out of its fixed assets, and once it achieves enough volume of sales, the sum total of profits from all those sales exceed its fixed cost base, and it turns a profit. It already has exceeded this hurdle in its past.
I'm fairly certain most of Amazon's retail businesses remain quite profitable. Some may not be, but they help to reinforce Amazon as the retail site of first resort. By the time I left Amazon in 2004 many of its retail businesses were already spinning off healthy profits. It is much harder to tell now from the outside because Amazon doesn't present a full P&L by business line to the outside world. You can see revenue by broad categories of the business, but most of its costs are lumped together in one giant blob on the income statement.
Very early in my career at Amazon, we could already easily model out and see when our revenue would give us enough income to exceed our fixed cost base. We could adjust when that would happen by choosing to invest more or less aggressively, but given our growth rates, it was always just felt like a matter of when, not if, we'd turn a profit.  Besides, we were most obsessed with free cash flow. Most armchair analysts love to dissect gross margin and net income because those are simpler to understand and easier to compute from public financial statements, but there are many problems with just looking at gross margin that any analyst worth their paycheck should understand.
Does Amazon lose money on sales of some individual items? For sure. The first Kindle ebooks that were priced at $9.99 when Amazon had to pay more than that per copy to publisher were one example. Giant, heavy electronics items that Amazon sometimes ships for free when the shipping cost is clearly non-trivial and cost more than the usual thin margins on such goods are another.
But while such exceptions in the catalog make for great copy (it's fun to link to such items in your story and let users see the evidence firsthand, especially when the item is
some strange piece of machinery that maybe a handful of people in the world would ever order
), but don't be mistaken. The vast vast majority of products Amazon sells it makes a profit on. Over time, more of these products that inadvertently sell at a loss will be corrected so that no longer happens, and what remains will be products Amazon intentionally uses as loss leaders.
The platform of Amazon is profitable, too. When other people sell products on Amazon Marketplace the gross margin is huge. I sell a used book on Amazon, it takes a cut of the transaction, I am the one packing and shipping that item to the buyer. You don't have to be a financial whiz to understand the cost of that transaction to Amazon is minimal.
If Amazon has so many businesses that do make a profit, then why is it still showing quarterly losses, and why has even free cash flow decreased in recent years?
Because Amazon has boundless ambition. It wants to eat global retail. This is one area where the press and pundits accept Amazon's statements at face value.
Given that giant mission, Amazon has decided to continue to invest to arm itself for a much larger scale of business. If it were purely a software business, its fixed cost investments for this journey would be lower, but the amount of capital required to grow a business that has to ship millions of packages to customers all over the world quickly is something only a handful of companies in the world could even afford. Joey Chestnut doesn't just wake up one day and win the Coney Island hot dog eating contest every year, he has to spend months of training to prepare his digestive system for the feat.
Amazon has seen that lowering its shipping costs and increasing the speed of shipping items to customers is like a shot of adrenaline to customer's propensity to buy from them, and so it has doubled down on building more and more fulfillment centers around the world. When I joined Amazon it had one fulfillment center. Today it has dozens just

data.article_summary: 本文介绍了如何使用正射投影制作地图图标，特别适用于突出显示如飓风盆地等特定地球视图。正射投影能模拟从太空看地球的效果，常用于创建直观的全球或局部地图。文章详细说明了利用ArcGIS Pro创建自定义正射投影地图的步骤，以北 Atlantic、东 Pacific 及其他飓风盆地为例。通过设置特定经纬度，调整投影中心，并使用“擦除”工具处理背景，最终生成简化的地图图标。这些图标可以导出为 .png 或 .svg 格式，用于各种用途。文章还强调了图标设计的简洁性，以确保其在小尺寸下的清晰度。最终结果是三个自定义的正射投影地图图标，可自由使用。

It’s an old projection, believed to have first been developed by the Ancient Egyptians and Greeks. In our time this perspective feels natural since our culture has assimilated how our planet looks from a spacecraft. A good example is Earth’s first portrait, taken from Apollo 8 mission astronauts in 1968:
Earthrise, taken on December 24, 1968, by Apollo 8 astronaut William Anders.
This projection only shows a portion of earth at any given time. Cartographers can use this projection effectively to highlight a particular view of earth in a way that is immediately and intuitively understood.
For our example we are going to be helping people understand Hurricane Basins. We will create custom orthographic maps and then export them as .png files (you could do .svg) to become icons we can use and share. Icons are simplified pictures that represent real things. data.title: India: Income Tax Bill allows officials to forcibly access social media, email
data.author: LordAtlas
data.article_summary: 2025年7月21日，印度议会委员会发布了关于《2025年所得税法案》的报告，保留了允许税务官员在搜查和扣押行动中强制访问个人社交媒体和私人电子邮件的条款。该法案旨在简化和合理化1961年《所得税法》及其多年来的修正案。尽管专家和利益相关者对条款中的隐私问题提出质疑，建议限制访问权限并要求记录访问理由，但议会委员会认为这些条款必要，未做修改。委员会强调，在许多搜查行动中，纳税人不愿分享密码，而电子记录中常发现 incriminating 证据，如WhatsApp和电子邮件通信。此外，新法案大幅简化了现行法律，将条文从819条减至536条，章节从47章减至23章。

Parliamentary panel retains Income Tax Bill provisions allowing tax officials to forcibly access social media, private email
The government on July 21, 2025 tabled the 4,575 page report in the Lok Sabha.

File photo shows police stand outside as IT officials conducting surprise raid. The parliamentary panel appointed to review the new Income Tax Bill 2025 proposed by the government has retained the provisions empowering tax officials to access, forcibly if necessary, the social media and private emails of people they are conducting search and seizure operations.
| Photo Credit: The Hindu
The Parliamentary Select Committee appointed to review the
new Income Tax Bill 2025
proposed by the government has retained the provisions in the new Bill empowering tax officials to access, forcibly if necessary, the social media and private emails of people they are conducting search and seizure operations on.
The Income Tax Bill 2025
was introduced in the Lok Sabha in February 2025. The aim behind the Bill, as per the government, is to simplify and rationalise the existing Income Tax Act 1961 and the numerous amendments that have been made to it over the decades since it was introduced. It was then sent to a Select Committee, chaired by Baijayant Panda, for a review.
The government on Monday (July 21, 2025) tabled the 4,575 page report in the Lok Sabha.
The new Bill’s expanded scope of powers given to tax officials during search and seizure operations has drawn criticism and calls for change, including from the experts the Select Committee consulted during its review.
Stricter searches
According to the new Bill, if a person is found to be in possession or control of any books of account, or other documents and information maintained digitally, on computer systems, or stored electronically, then they must provide the designated income tax officer “reasonable technical and other assistance (including access code, by whatever name called) as may be necessary” to enable the officer to inspect “any information, electronic records and communication or data contained in or available on such computer systems”.
Further, the Bill also says that the authorised officer can gain access to these electronic systems by “overriding the access code to any said computer system, or virtual digital space, where the access code thereof is not available”.
A ‘virtual digital space’ includes social media accounts, online investment accounts, trading accounts, bank accounts, remote server or cloud server, and digital application platforms.
According to the report, the stakeholders the Committee consulted during its examination of the Bill raised red flags regarding these provisions.
Changes “not feasible”
The stakeholders suggested that the power to gain the access codes of social media accounts be placed out of the purview of relevant sections of the new Bill. They also stated that the Bill should make clear that, if access is gained to personal email addresses and computer systems, the use of these accounts “shall be made only to the extent it is relevant for Income-Tax Act and not for any purpose beyond the Income-tax Act”.
Others suggested that “tangible reasons for seeking access may be recorded in writing prior to any such activity being undertaken”.
The Select Committee, however, has argued that the provisions in the new Bill are necessary and therefore suggested no changes to them.
“Various incriminating evidences and material are found/seized from electronic records including WhatsApp communications, emails, etc,” it said in its report. “In most of the cases of search operation the taxpayers do not share the password/login credential of online forums/portals/e-mail accounts, etc.
“This is because various encrypted communication modes are being used by tax payers to communicate and discuss their unaccounted transactions,” it added. “The amendment has been rightly made to rationalise the provisions. Thus, the suggestion is not feasible.”
With regard to the stakeholders’ suggestion that tangible reasons for providing access be provided, the Committee said this was “not feasible” as it “seeks to provide safeguard in the statute to prevent abuse of power by Revenue officials as well as protect the privacy of taxpayers”.
Significant simplification
According to the Committee’s report, the new Bill is a big step forward in simplifying India’s income tax legislation. The new Bill has pared down the number of words in the law to 2,59,676 from the 5,12,535 in the Income Tax Act 1961.
The number of chapters have also been reduced to 23 from 47, and the number of sections have been slashed to 536 from 819. On the other hand, to provide greater clarity, the new Bill has increased the number of tables it incorporates to 57 from 18, and the number of formulae to 46 from 6.

data.title: Hiding messages in a deck playing cards
data.author: ashfn
data.article_summary: 这篇文章探讨了如何利用52张扑克牌的排列顺序来存储文本数据。作者首先计算出52张牌的排列组合数为8×10^67，对应约225位二进制数据。通过引入Lehmer码，作者将牌序转换为一种阶乘数系统，再将其转换为十进制数，从而实现大数据存储。为了使存储实用化，作者设计了一个包含32个符号（包括字母、标点和特殊符号）的字符集，每个符号用5位二进制表示，这样225位可以存储45个字符的信息。文章最后提供了Python代码示例，用于实现文本与225位数字之间的转换。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：通过扑克牌排列进行信息编码和加密的方法及其相关技术细节

不同观点：
• [sltkr] 认为博客中提到的“decimal”和“denary”是不准确的，因为在计算过程中并没有涉及到十进制数。他指出，转换一个排列到其索引时，实际上是将其转换为一个没有内在基数的整数，而不是十进制数。因此，像`decimalToFactoradic()`这样的函数命名是不准确的，建议改为`integerToFactoradic()`。

• [SetTheorist] 提到博客内容让他想起Bruce Schneier为小说《Cryptonomicon》设计的基于扑克牌的加密系统（Solitaire密码）。

• [ashfn] 分享了一种将文本转换为特定扑克牌顺序的方法，并提到其使用了Lehmer码，可以唯一识别每种排列，即每种洗牌方式。

• [lxgr] 对ashfn的内容表示赞赏，但指出可以通过运行整个加密算法而不仅仅是隐藏一条信息。

• [ComplexSystems] 建议通过使用Huffman或算术编码来提高带宽效率，并指出如果将标记设置为所有英语单词，每个单词大约需要9-10位，还可以进一步优化。

• [ilcavero] 分享了自己之前制作的关于factoradic编码的互动演示链接，表示很高兴找到同样对演示感兴趣的人。

• [zahlman] 提到在没有JavaScript的情况下只能看到纯色背景，并通过Python计算出这种方法提供的存储空间非常有限，大约为28字节。

• [zzo38computer] 指出还有其他五位字符集，如Baudot和Zork字符集，并建议可以使用其他基数的数字或不同的牌组（如塔罗牌）来增加信息容量。

• [a_t48] 建议通过使用非人头牌的方块方向来增加约45位的信息容量。

• [praptak] 提到使用常见物体进行编码在实际间谍活动中曾被使用，如CIA的鞋带代码。

• [mrdoornbos] 分享了自己在Commodore 64上实现Cryptonomicon中的Pontifex加密算法的经历。

• [russellbeattie] 提出一个不切实际但可能的方案，即为每种人类已知语言的每个句子分配一个数字，利用扑克牌组合的巨大数量来识别这些句子。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及到多个技术细节和优化方法，如字符集的选择、信息编码效率的提高和加密算法的应用。
• 评论中还提到了一些历史和实际应用的例子，如CIA的鞋带代码和小说中的加密系统，增加了讨论的趣味性和实用性。

44605169.article_summary: 这篇文章探讨了如何利用52张扑克牌的排列顺序来存储文本数据。作者首先计算出52张牌的排列组合数为8×10^67，对应约225位二进制数据。通过引入Lehmer码，作者将牌序转换为一种阶乘数系统，再将其转换为十进制数，从而实现大数据存储。为了使存储实用化，作者设计了一个包含32个符号（包括字母、标点和特殊符号）的字符集，每个符号用5位二进制表示，这样225位可以存储45个字符的信息。文章最后提供了Python代码示例，用于实现文本与225位数字之间的转换。

data.title: Writing your Clojure tests in EDN files
data.author: jacobobryant
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了Jacob O'Bryant对使用EDN文件进行快照测试的方法的简化和改进。之前的方法过于复杂，依赖控制反转，测试编写成本高。新方法简化了测试编写过程，测试代码类似于在REPL中运行，测试输入数据和预期结果保存在EDN文件中。测试运行程序自动执行代码并更新结果，开发者通过Git差异检查结果变化，决定是否接受更改或修复问题。此外，如果代码抛出异常或使用`tap>`捕获中间值，这些信息也会记录在测试文件中，方便调试。这种方法减少了认知负担，使测试编写更加便捷。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：使用不同文件格式和方法进行快照测试和验证测试

不同观点：
• [lyxell] 支持使用 **txtar 文件** 进行快照测试，其中一个字段包含预期输出，一个或多个字段包含输入。这种方法的优势在于大多数主流编程语言都有 txtar 解析器，因此可以轻松将整个测试套件跨语言移植。他以 Rust 的 txtar 库为例，说明这种方法的实际应用。

• [andersmurphy] 对 [lyxell] 的观点表示赞同，并补充提到这种预期测试的方式让他想起 **Jane Street 的 "expect" 测试**（提供了一个相关博客链接）。这表明 Jane Street 也有类似的测试实践，强调了预期输出和输入的紧密结合。

• [erichocean] 提出了另一种不同的测试方法，即 **SQL 数据库的测试**。他描述了一种测试 SQL 查询的方式：在一个 .sql 文件中包含查询语句，随后紧跟预期响应（作为 SQL 注释）。测试运行器会执行查询并验证其结果是否与注释中的预期响应匹配。这种方式可以包含数据库创建、插入数据等操作，并可以集成到 CI 基础设施中。

补充讨论：
• [lyxell] 的方法侧重于跨语言的快照测试，利用 txtar 文件的结构化特性，使其易于移植和维护。

• [andersmurphy] 通过引用 Jane Street 的博客，补充了关于 "expect" 测试的背景信息，表明这种测试方法在某些社区中已经比较成熟。

• [erichocean] 的方法则专注于 **SQL 查询的测试**，展示了如何使用注释来存储预期结果，这种方法特别适合数据库相关的测试，并且强调了其在 CI 环境中的应用。

争议焦点：
• 没有直接的争议，但讨论中涉及了不同领域（通用编程语言测试与 SQL 数据库测试）的测试方法。可以看出，不同方法适用于不同的场景，但都围绕如何高效进行快照测试和验证测试这一核心主题。

44616405.article_content:
Home
Docs
News
GitHub
Writing your tests in EDN files
Jacob O'Bryant
| 19 Jul 2025
I've
previously written
about my latest
approach to unit tests (which I have been informed is called "snapshot testing"):
[Y]ou define only the input data for your function, and then the expected return value is
generated by calling your function. The expected value is saved to an EDN file and checked into
source, at which point you ensure the expected value is, in fact, what you expect. Then going
forward, the unit test simply checks that what the function returns still matches what’s in the
EDN file. If it’s supposed to change, you regenerate the EDN file and inspect it before
committing.
I still like that general approach, however my previous implementation of it ended up being a little
too heavy-weight/too reliant on inversion of control. The test runner code had all these things
built into it for dealing with fixtures, providing a seeded database value, and other concerns.
Writing new tests ended up requiring a little too much cognitive overhead, and I reverted back to
manual testing (via a mix of the REPL and the browser).
I have now simplified the approach so that writing tests is basically the same as running code in
the REPL, and there's barely anything baked into the test runner itself that you have to remember. I
put all my tests in EDN files like this (named with the pattern
my_namespace_test.edn
):
{:require
[[com.yakread.model.recommend :refer :all]
[com.yakread.lib.test :as t]
[clojure.data.generators :as gen]],
:tests
[{:eval (weight 0), :result 1.0}
_
{:eval (weight 1), :result 0.9355069850316178}
_
{:eval (weight 5), :result 0.7165313105737893}
...]}
(
weight
is a simple function for the
forgetting curve
,
which I'm using in
Yakread's
recommendation algorithm.)
I only write the
:eval
part of each test case. The test runner evaluates that code, adds in the
:result
part, and
pprint
s it all back to the test file. Right now there isn't a concept of
"passing" or "failing" tests. Instead, when the tests are right, you check them into git; if any
test results change, you'll see it in the diff. Then you can decide whether to commit the new
results (if the change is expected) or go fix the bug (if it wasn't). If I had CI tests for my
personal projects, I'd probably add a flag to have the test runner report any test cases with
changed results as failed.
In my
lib.test
namespace I've added a couple helper functions, such as a
t/with-db
function that
populates an in-memory
XTDB
database value:
{:require
[[com.yakread.work.digest :refer :all]
[com.yakread.lib.test :as t]
[clojure.data.generators :as gen]],
:tests
[{:eval
(t/with-db
[db
[{:xt/id "user1", :user/email "user1@example.com"}
{:xt/id "user2",
:user/email "user2@example.com",
:user/digest-last-sent #time/instant "2000-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]]
(queue-send-digest
{:biff/db db,
:biff/now #time/instant "2000-01-01T16:00:01Z",
:biff/queues
{:work.digest/send-digest
(java.util.concurrent.PriorityBlockingQueue. 11 (fn [a b]))}}
:start)),
:result
{:biff.pipe/next
({:biff.pipe/current :biff.pipe/queue,
:biff.pipe.queue/id :work.digest/send-digest,
:biff.pipe.queue/job
{:user/email "user1@example.com", :xt/id "user1"}})}}
...]}
(
queue-send-digest
returns a list of users who need to be sent an email digest of their RSS subscriptions and other
content.)
I like this approach a lot more than the old one: you just write regular code, with test helper
functions for seeded databases or whatever if you need them. It's been pretty convenient to write my
"REPL" code in these
_test.edn
files and then have the results auto-update as I develop the
function under test.
There are a couple other doodads: if the code in
:eval
throws an exception, the test runner writes
the exception as data into the test case, albeit under an
:ex
key instead of under
:results
:
{:require
[[com.yakread.model.recommend :refer :all]
[com.yakread.lib.test :as t]
[clojure.data.generators :as gen]],
:tests
[{:eval (weight 0)
:ex
{:cause "oh no",
:data {:it's "sluggo"},
:via
[{:type clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo,
:message "oh no",
:data {:it's "sluggo"},
:at
[com.yakread.model.recommend$eval75461$weight__75462
invoke
"recommend.clj"
60]}],
:trace
[[com.yakread.model.recommend$eval75461$weight__75462
invoke
"recommend.clj"
60]
[tmp418706$eval83727 invokeStatic "NO_SOURCE_FILE" 0]
[tmp418706$eval83727 invoke "NO_SOURCE_FILE" -1]
[clojure.lang.Compiler eval "Compiler.java" 7700]
[clojure.lang.Compiler eval "Compiler.java" 7655]
[clojure.core$eval invokeStatic "core.clj" 3232]
[clojure.core$eval invoke "core.clj" 3228]]}}
...]}
The stack trace gets truncated so it only contains frames from your
:eval
code (mostly—I
could truncate it a little more).
I also capture any
tap>
'd values and insert those into the test case, whether or not there was an
exception. It's handy for inspecting intermediate values:
:tests
[{:eval (weight 1),
:result 0.9355069850316178,
:tapped ["hello there" "exponent: -1/15"]}
...
And that's it. If y

data.title: Comparison of MGR, SunView, OpenWindows and X11R6 (2022)
data.author: hualapais
data.article_summary:
这篇文章介绍了1990年推出的Solbourne S3000一体化工作站，该机器采用了33MHz的Panasonic MN10501处理器（代号KAP），与1989年的Sun SPARCstation形成竞争。Solbourne通过其母公司松下引入了多处理器支持，甚至早于Sun实现这一功能。由于KAP处理器的缺陷，Solbourne的机器主要限于单处理器使用，而更大的SMP系统则使用了富士通等其他厂商的CPU。

文章还提到，作者通过升级使该机器拥有56MB ECC RAM、SCSI2SD和从S4100取来的256K L2缓存CPU模块，且其单色显示器与SBus兼容。Solbourne的OS/MP系统基于SunOS 4.x，几乎完全兼容Sun的系统。

最后，文章详细描述了如何使用`screendump`工具和自编的`sol2sun.c`程序将Solbourne的屏幕截图转换为Sun兼容的格式，并在其他系统上查看。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：早期桌面环境与现代桌面环境的比较，以及未来AI界面可能的演变方向。

不同观点：
• [cadamsdotcom] 认为早期的桌面环境从空白状态开始，而现代桌面环境提供了更多的视觉指引和提示，帮助用户理解可以进行的操作。例如，Windows 95的开始菜单是一个重要的转折点。他还将此与当前的LLM（大型语言模型）进行类比，指出LLM目前缺乏类似于“开始菜单”的直观界面，导致新手用户容易受挫。他期待一个AI的“开始菜单”出现。

• [breadwinner] 对比了过去的计算机和现代计算机，指出1986年的Sun工作站尽管只有16MB内存，但具备良好的网络功能和图形处理能力。他认为，尽管今天的计算机内存增加了1000倍，但整体性能和效率未必显著提升，甚至过去的一些终端设备（如NCD）与今天的Chromebook一样好用。

• [buescher] 回忆了90年代在Linux上使用mgr窗口管理器的经历，并提到Slackware发行版中包含的Andrew用户界面系统和xview等应用程序。

• [sprash] 认为MGR窗口管理器有潜力回归，尤其是结合现代的绘图技术，如着色器和纹理。他指出，现代UI本质上仍然是低带宽输入输出系统，而绘图操作可以由GPU管理。

• [anthk] 提供了如何在现代系统上模拟90年代中期Motif桌面的详细指南，包括使用emwm、xfile、classic-colors等工具，以及如何配置Emacs以获得接近90年代的字体和界面体验。他还提到了一位西班牙爱好者通过补丁让旧窗口管理器在现代系统上运行的例子。

补充讨论：
• 评论中还涉及了一些具体的技术工具和资源链接，如Gopher和Mosaic浏览器的使用、BFG浏览器的介绍以及如何配置IRC和Usenet客户端。
• 争议的焦点之一是现代计算机是否比过去的计算机更有效率。部分评论者（如breadwinner）认为尽管硬件性能大幅提升，但整体用户体验和功能未必显著改善。
• 另一个讨论点是早期计算机和现代计算机的UI设计演变，尤其是如何让用户更容易理解和使用系统的功能。

主要讨论点：户外与室内身体活动对认知的影响及其相关因素

不同观点：
• **lenerdenator** 认为天气是影响户外活动的主要因素，尤其是在夏季炎热的情况下，因此更倾向于选择室内活动。
• **jasonpeacock** 强调身体活动本身对认知的益处，无论是在室内还是室外，并引用《Spark》一书中的研究，指出早晨的身体活动能提高学习效果。
• **thefz** 以讽刺的语气暗示，有些人可能希望通过药物获得户外锻炼的好处，而不实际进行户外活动。
• **thewebguyd** 提出了一种观点，认为在室内通过放置植物或增加高照度灯光模拟阳光，可能也能获得类似于户外活动的好处，强调了绿植和自然元素的作用。
• **upofadown** 关注实验中应控制光照水平/类型和空气质量等变量，质疑室内外活动之间的具体区别。
• **globular-toast** 指出户外环境的安全问题，如交通，使得儿童更难以进行户外活动。
• **manco** 对标题的准确性提出质疑，认为遗漏了“身体”一词可能导致对讨论主题的误解。

补充讨论：
• 天气、绿植、自然光照和空气质量等环境因素被认为是影响户外与室内活动选择的重要因素。
• 研究控制变量的讨论，特别是光照和空气质量，是理解户外与室内活动差异的关键。
• 户外活动的安全性（如交通问题）在现代社会中可能成为阻碍户外活动的一个重要因素。
• 对标题准确性的质疑反映了参与者对讨论主题清晰度的关注。

data.title: Australian anti-porn group claims responsibility for Steams new censorship rules
data.author: kradeelav
data.article_summary: 澳大利亚反色情组织Collective Shout声称，由于其向支付处理商（如Visa、Mastercard、PayPal等）施压，成功促使Steam下架大量色情游戏并实施更严格的审核标准。Valve表示，此举是因支付处理商的压力，而Collective Shout则归功于其发起的消费者运动。此前，Waypoint曾报道此事，但随后无解释地撤下了两篇文章，作者Ana Valens称其被撤是因内容争议，而非报道错误。Collective Shout自2009年成立以来，一直反对媒体和流行文化中的女性物化和少女性化，曾成功推动一些针对音乐人和电子游戏的抵制活动。尽管面临骚扰，Collective Shout计划继续推动清除涉及不当内容的其他游戏。

不同观点：
• 一些评论关注新闻审查和媒体的独立性。例如，[perihelions]提到Vice的关闭和其文章被下架，认为这是新闻 journalism 和金融资本控制的内容农场之间的区别。
• [NewsaHackO]提出关于支付系统被武器化的问题，指出在传统支付方式合谋抵制某些业务的情况下，是否存在其他可能的解决方案，特别是加密货币的失败。

补充讨论：
• [whatshisface]指出信用卡公司有动机隐藏某些信息，因为他们将用户的信用历史数据出售，并希望用户不会阻止这种行为。
• [j-bos]质疑澳大利亚反恶习组织在全球范围内的影响力，尤其是澳大利亚在赌博问题上的矛盾立场。
• [freedomben]认为需要对信用卡处理公司进行监管，以防止他们歧视性地拒绝服务，并呼吁停止让他们对整个经济进行重税。
• [tmaly]建议建立通用标准来识别用户的法律居住国，并明确公司在不同司法管辖区运营所需遵守的法律。
• [Insanity]对某些游戏被下架表示看法，认为一些游戏确实质量可疑，但也指出反色情组织可能有更广泛的反表达议程。
• [lupusreal]认为反色情和反表达的法律和价值观不仅限于美国，而是整个英语国家都在推进。
• [jakupovic]简短地表达了一种自由意志主义的观点："如果你不想看某物，那就不要看它"。
• [Acrobatic_Road]暗示希望有一种纯粹的点对点电子现金系统，以避免通过金融机构进行支付。
• [ChrisArchitect]提到Steam审查政策的背后有强大的盟友，暗示某些组织有更大的影响力。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于新闻独立性与资本控制之间的矛盾，以及支付系统被用于审查和武器化的可能性。
• 另一个争议点是反色情和反表达组织的全球影响力及其背后的价值观冲突。

44636369.article_content:
(Image credit: Valve Software)
Collective Shout, an Australian anti-pornography group, has claimed credit for Steam's recent removal of a large number of sexually explicit games and new,
stricter moderation guidelines
regarding such material. In a statement to PC Gamer,
Valve cited pressure from payment processors
like credit card companies and Paypal for the move, while Collective Shout touted its open letter and consumer campaign targeting payment processors for inciting that pressure.
This was first reported by Waypoint, which has since pulled its two articles on the subject without explanation. The articles' author, Ana Valens,
has alleged
that Vice's parent company, Savage Ventures, removed the articles due to concerns over their controversial content rather than any error in the reporting.
Collective Shout began in 2009, co-founded by self-described "pro-life feminist" Melinda Tankard Reist. Collective Shout describes itself as "A grassroots campaigning movement against the objectification of women and sexualization of girls in media, advertising, and popular culture". To date, it has been involved in:
Related articles
Steam's got a new rule that puts the kibosh on 'certain kinds of adult only content' that make Visa and Mastercard sad
Valve confirms credit card companies pressured it to delist certain adult games from Steam
As fans lose it over sanitised nudity and violence, Ready or Not devs promise they haven't changed their 'creative vision': 'We’ve only made changes where absolutely required'
Unsuccessful efforts to
ban Snoop Dogg and Eminem
from Australia.
A successful 2015 campaign to prevent Tyler the Creator from touring Australia.
A successful 2015 campaign to pressure Target and Kmart to
stop selling Grand Theft Auto 5
in Australia.
A petition to ban the game No Mercy from sale, which ultimately led to the developers
pulling it from Steam
.
An unsuccessful petition to ban Detroit: Become Human from sale in Australia.
On July 7, Collective Shout
shared an update
to its No Mercy Change.org campaign calling on supports to email payment processors (including PayPal, MasterCard, Visa, and Discover) to demand that they "cut ties with Steam and itch.io" over "hundreds of r*pe, incest, and child-abuse games." This was followed by an
open letter from Collective Shout
asking that they "immediately cease processing payments on Steam and itch.io and any other platforms hosting similar games."
Collective Shout
later wrote
that 1,067 individuals called and emailed payment processors as part of this campaign. It's unclear when Valve updated its TOS for developers, but the mass deletion of sex games appears to have begun on July 15 judging by
SteamDB's recorded package changes
. On the 18th, Valve confirmed to us that this was in response to pressure from payment processors.
All these porn sick brain rotted pedo gamer fetishists so desperate to get their hands on rape-my-little-sister incest games they’re now exchanging clues on how to find them so that they don’t all die overnight
July 18, 2025
Collective Shout claimed victory that same day. "Since we launched our campaign calling on Payment Processors to stop facilitating payments for rape, incest, sexual torture and child-abuse themed games on Steam, they have added a new rule to their policies + removed hundreds of these games," the group
wrote on Twitter
.
In follow-up tweets, Collective Shout wrote that it was experiencing harassment from "misogynistic gamers" over the campaign, and that there remain 82 games "tagged with rape and incest" that the group will continue campaigning to have taken down⁠—this is of a claimed 500 games that the group took issue with.

Those numbers do not add up, though. Counting up all "Removed" and "Retired" games on SteamDB since the 15th, I got 456 hits, but that includes double counts for most of the offending games (many of which were both "Removed" and "Retired"), DLC and demos for those games (also given the double-r treatment), and a number of unrelated games that were taken off Steam during this time.
"All these porn sick brain rotted pedo gamer fetishists so desperate to get their hands on rape-my-little-sister incest games they’re now exchanging clues on how to find them so that they don’t all die overnight," Collective Shout co-founder Melinda Tankard Reist
tweeted on July 18th
. Later that day, she shared a long Tweet thread
further claiming victory
with Steam's decision.
The two retracted articles from Waypoint appear to be the first among the games press to point out the connection between Collective Shout and the recent changes on Steam, a connection which is public knowledge⁠—by Collective Shout's own statements⁠—and not an allegation

data.article_summary: 作者Mark Pesce在2025年撰文讲述自己为了避免入境美国时遇到麻烦，删除了所有社交媒体账号和相关应用，包括Mastodon、Twitter和各种约会软件。他指出，2025年是社交媒体从自我表达变为自我束缚的转折点，所有线上活动都可能被监控、分析并用于不利于个人的判断。尽管知道完全删除并不可能，仍选择尽可能清除个人记录，以减少潜在风险。作者强调，面对日益严密的监控，个人必须反复拒绝被全面监控的诱惑，但他也承认没有简单的解决方案，只能在恐惧和不安中尝试自我保护。最终，他将在入境时接受检查，不确定删除是否有效。
data.comments_summary:

• AlexandrB则表示自己早在2015年左右就停止了在社交媒体上发布任何内容，并对其他人忍受Meta和Twitter等平台的滥用行为感到震惊。

• namlem认为这是一种无稽之谈的恐慌营销。
• newsclues指出，在旅行前删除社交媒体账号可能被视为可疑行为，且账号数据可能并未真正删除。
• mahirsaid补充提到Reddit也存在类似问题。
• pembrook认为，法律上并没有发生变化，问题的核心在于边境巡逻队被赋予了过多的权力，导致每年有数百人因愚蠢或无害的原因被拒绝入境。

• 讨论中涉及到对美国边境政策的批评和对个人隐私保护的关注，特别是对社交媒体账号在入境审查中的作用的担忧。
• 有人提到对那些使用真实姓名进行政治活动的人的同情和对其不吸取历史教训的愤怒。

44637700.article_content:
Columnists
8
I just deleted my entire social media presence before visiting the US – and I'm a citizen
8
In 2025, social media has moved from self-expression to self-entrapment
Mark Pesce
Mon 21 Jul 2025
//
17:01 UTC
Column
We don't want to believe what we deeply understand: nothing is really deleted, and someone, somewhere can (and probably will) use that record against us.
It's possible that someone and somewhere will be a Customs and Border Protection agent at a US airport, as by now we've all heard a story of how has prevented a few unlucky souls from entering the USA – after spending hours or days in a holding cell – because of
some post or other activity
that someone decided made them unfit to cross the border.
Now that's it's happening, what can we do?
For what it's worth, I just pulled the plug on my much-beloved Mastodon account...
Mastodon account deletion notice - Click to enlarge
...as part of a more comprehensive effort to sanitize my online presence.
First I deleted all the hookup apps on my phone, before binning random and never used social apps like Periscope (remember them?) and Snap.
Next, three years after I rage-quit Twitter, I "deactivated" my account. I haven't checked, but assume new management changed its terms of service so xAI can continue use my nearly 300,000 tweets to train the next iteration of
MechaHitler
.
2025 was the year when was when it all changed. When socials transformed from self-expression to entrapment
I also assume that if I rejoined Facebook – 15 years after I got the measure of Mark Zuckerberg and "deactivated" my account – Meta would offer to restore all my past posts and connections.
Oh yes, we've created quite a record of ourselves.
As I continued my purge, I went through the last few years of photos and scrubbed anything I felt might even be moderately provocative or offensive to anyone who might be looking. That screenshot of a news article? That random bit of art that I photographed? That poster? That face? I scrubbed them all.
Friends note that I've got an American passport – what could possibly go wrong?
I don't know, I reply. But it seems sensible to reduce my attack surface. So the photos go into the memory hole, and finally, my Mastodon account, my alternative to the radioactive bonfire socials of Twitter, small and humble and very much allergic to Nazis. Hitting that "delete" button hurt. But it had to happen.
If you want a picture of the future, imagine humans checking AI didn't make a mistake – forever
AI's the end of the Shell as we know it and I feel fine … but insecure
AI can't replace devs until it understands office politics
Meta's AI, built on ill-gotten content, can probably build a digital you
Remember the year: 2025 was when it all changed. When socials transformed from self-expression to entrapment. From now on, every word you write and every photo and video and podcast you post will be analyzed, weighed, and judged for something far more sinister than targeted advertising.
Didn't we always knew this day would come? As soon as we started leaving social tracings on the internet –
all the way back, 45 years, to Usenet
– we knew our own words could come back to haunt us. When that was just "other people," we never cared very much and kept on sh*tposting. Now that more powerful entities have become increasingly watchful, we find ourselves careful, censorious of ourselves, and of others.
We pray to be forgotten, so that when a border agent says, "Papers, please?" they find nothing of note to indicate that you're the wrong kind of person. That's not new. Our complicity in compiling the record used against us, that part is.
I don't have any simple solutions. I don't think there are any. The only thing that can save us from this is our own agency. We have decide to reject the lure of "total information awareness" - and not just once, but on every occasion, hundreds of times a day.
Before you read this, I will have presented myself at the US border – all shiny and clean and newly sanitized – where I will flash my US passport and smile. They'll let me in. Unless someone somewhere has a dataset that wasn't deleted, and instead got integrated into a
profiling database
that an ICE agent has at their fingertips. Something that tips the scales toward a deeper examination of my suitability.
Until I make it through the gates at immigration, I won't know whether any of this flurry of self-censoring means anything more than a way to manage my fear and paranoia.
And I suspect that's the point of it. ®
